【RBNZ raises OCR 25bps to 2.75%; risk of further large hikes reduced】The RBNZ raised the official cash rate (OCR) 25bps to 2.75%. It said fuel-driven inflation in the quarter to June rose to 4.1%, while core inflation, expected wage growth and inflation expectations remain consistent with inflation returning to the 1–3% target range by mid-2027 and the 2% midpoint by late next year. After weak growth in the June quarter, the economy has likely resumed an uneven recovery the bank expects to strengthen and broaden. Global risks could alter commodity prices and export demand; the recovery could be stronger or weaker than expected and price pressures could cause inflation to persist longer. The committee will remain vigilant and act if necessary to ensure inflation returns to the 2% midpoint in the medium term. It said gradual withdrawal of policy stimulus is appropriate to return inflation to target while supporting growth and employment, and that today’s decision lowers the risk that further large rate hikes will be needed; future policy will depend on the committee’s assessment of the balance of medium‑term inflation risks.

China Stocks Track Asian Peers Lower — The Shanghai Composite fell 1.0% to 3,942 on Wednesday, while the Shenzhen Component declined 1.5% to 13,669, extending the previous session's losses as a broad risk-off sentiment swept through Asian markets. Investor appetite was dampened by a renewed surge in oil prices, with escalating tensions in the Middle East stoking concerns over potential supply disruptions, adding to global inflationary pressures and reinforcing expectations that major central banks could maintain tighter monetary settings for longer. Meanwhile, Putin and Xi discussed a potential trilateral meeting with Trump during China's APEC summit in November, while Xi is also set to visit Washington later this month for talks with the US president. Notable laggards included Foxconn Industrial Internet (-1.8%), Zijin Mining Group (-2.1%), CATL (-1.8%), and Zhongji Innolight (-2.8%).

【中國鐵路通訊訊號集團有限公司原黨委副書記徐宗祥被開除黨籍】中央紀委國家監委網站9月2日通報，據中央紀委國家監委駐國務院國資委紀檢監察組、湖南省紀委監委訊息：日前，經中央紀委國家監委批准，中央紀委國家監委駐國務院國資委紀檢監察組和湖南省邵陽市監委對中國鐵路通訊訊號集團有限公司原黨委副書記、總經理徐宗祥嚴重違紀違法問題進行了立案審查調查。經查，徐宗祥喪失理想信念，背棄初心使命，參加迷信活動；罔顧中央八項規定精神，借用管理和服務物件車輛，公車私用，借為兒子操辦婚宴之機斂財；違背組織原則，不如實報告個人有關事項，違規為他人謀取人事方面利益並收受財物；廉潔底線失守，違規持有非上市公司股份並獲利，利用職務影響為親屬經營活動提供幫助，由他人支付應由本人支付的費用，違規收受禮金、購物卡，接受可能影響公正執行公務的娛樂活動安排，搞權色交易；違反生活紀律；違反國家法律法規，辦理和使用虛假身份證件；將公權力異化為謀取私利的工具，大肆收錢斂財，退而不休，利用職務便利在企業經營、專案承攬等方面為他人謀利，並非法收受鉅額財物。徐宗祥嚴重違反黨的政治紀律、中央八項規定精神、組織紀律、廉潔紀律、生活紀律，構成嚴重職務違法並涉嫌受賄、利用影響力受賄犯罪，且在黨的十八大後不收斂、不收手，性質嚴重，影響惡劣，應予嚴肅處理。依據《中國共產黨紀律處分條例》《中華人民共和國監察法》《中華人民共和國公職人員政務處分法》等有關規定，經國務院國資委黨委研究，決定給予徐宗祥開除黨籍處分；經中央紀委國家監委駐國務院國資委紀檢監察組研究，決定按規定取消其享受的待遇；收繳其違紀違法所得；湖南省邵陽市監委將其涉嫌犯罪問題移送檢察機關依法審查起訴，所涉財物一併移送。

【BOJ hawk Takata says flexible rate hikes needed amid domestic financial and external developments】BOJ board member Takata said the bank should flexibly raise interest rates after assessing domestic financial conditions and overseas developments. 【SK Group chairman Choi considers Japan memory fab, flags possible joint production with Kioxia】SK Group chairman Choi Tae-won said the company is considering building a new memory-chip fab in Japan and may pursue joint production with Kioxia, the Japanese NAND flash maker in which SK Hynix holds a stake. He said SK would be willing to partner if SK Hynix can be included in Kioxia’s future strategic plan and identified joint production, R&D and shared supply chains as possible cooperation areas, adding that SK would end its investment in Kioxia if no form of cooperation can be established. Citing booming AI-driven data-center demand, Choi said there is a 20–30% shortfall in data-center storage semiconductors and called Japan—with its concentration of equipment, materials and parts suppliers—an attractive candidate for overseas capacity on risk and cultural grounds.

【Wright says 17 mln barrels transited Strait of Hormuz on Monday; Kpler tracking shows no oil cargoes】Per Reuters, US Energy Secretary Wright said 17 mln barrels of crude transited the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, the highest flow since Iran-related conflict disrupted shipping. That contrasts with preliminary vessel-tracking from Kpler, which showed only five bulk carriers transited on Monday and recorded no oil cargoes. 【Australian growth unexpectedly accelerates; RESERVE BANK OF AUSTRALIA rate-hike odds rise】Australia's economy unexpectedly accelerated in Q2, strengthening the case for further tightening by the RESERVE BANK OF AUSTRALIA. The Australian Bureau of Statistics reported Q2 GDP +0.4% QoQ (consensus 0.3%) and +2.1% YoY (consensus 1.8%). The prints suggest prior RBA measures to curb inflation have not materially slowed activity. GDP will be a key input ahead of the RBA's Sep 28–29 meeting. NAB economist Sally Auld, after stronger-than-expected inflation, now expects a September hike and said the risk of a further November increase "leans to the upside." The RBA held rates unchanged for a second straight meeting last month after three hikes from Feb–May.

European Gas Advances on Rising US-Iran Hostilities — European natural gas prices rose further to €75/MWh on Wednesday, the highest level since January 2023, as rising hostilities between the US and Iran heightened fears of a prolonged disruption to LNG supplies from the Persian Gulf. Iran struck back at US military bases in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain following the latest US attacks on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz, which President Trump said were in response to Iranian mine-laying attempts in the waterway and an earlier attack on a US base in Jordan. The escalation comes as LNG flows through the strait were almost at a standstill, tightening supplies and forcing European buyers to compete more aggressively for alternative cargoes as they prepare for the winter heating season. With European gas storage levels still below their usual seasonal levels, an extended disruption would leave the region more exposed to sharper price volatility once colder weather arrives.

Japan 10-Year Yield Scales 30-Year Highs — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield climbed above 3% on Wednesday, reaching its highest level since 1996 as surging oil prices heightened inflation concerns and strengthened expectations for imminent interest rate hikes. Japan’s deteriorating fiscal outlook, amid the Takaichi administration’s plans for massive spending and tax cuts, also fueled the surge in domestic bond yields. Oil prices advanced for a third consecutive session amid escalating hostilities between the US and Iran, raising concerns over further disruptions to energy flows from the Middle East. Higher energy costs exacerbate import-driven inflation in Japan given its reliance on oil imports. Meanwhile, the Bank of Japan is increasingly expected to raise interest rates this month, with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urging BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda to take “decisive” monetary steps to combat yen weakness.

Heating Oil Surges to Record High — US heating oil prices surged past $4.70 per gallon in early September, hitting a fresh record and leaving prices about 100% higher than a year earlier, driven by tightening distillate supplies. Industry data showed that US distillate inventories fell by 300,000 barrels in the week ending August 28, adding to evidence of increasingly constrained supplies ahead of the winter heating season. Tightness is also evident across the broader refined-fuel market, with US diesel futures reaching a 52-month high and the diesel crack spread climbing to a record level. Meanwhile, US refinery utilization has remained at or above 95% for 12 consecutive weeks, leaving limited spare capacity to replenish inventories or offset further disruptions. Supply risks remained elevated amid renewed tensions between the US and Iran, raising concerns over oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz, while Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries have further constrained global refining capacity.

【Institutions expect RBNZ to hike 25bps in Sept; year‑end OCR seen near 3% or higher】Major banks and a Reuters survey expect the RBNZ to raise the OCR by 25bps in September. ASB projects a peak OCR around 3.3%; Westpac sees the OCR at about 3% by year‑end with a peak near 3.3%. CITIGROUP expects a 25bp move and says the RBNZ would still need three further hikes to return the OCR to neutral. A Reuters survey likewise forecasts 25bps in September, with over two‑thirds of respondents anticipating at least one more hike and year‑end OCR of 3% or higher. ANZ expects 25bps in September and likely another hike in October, saying the November election is unlikely to prevent a return to neutral. BNZ forecasts 25bps in September followed by 25bp increases at each meeting through May 2027, taking the OCR to a 4% peak. ING notes its May economic forecasts implied a year‑end OCR of about 3% and a flat path next year. Brown Brothers Harriman supports a 25bp move and flags scope for further tightening given inflation remaining above target and stronger domestic growth.

【BNZ: RBNZ to hike 25bps at each meeting until cash rate reaches 4%】BNZ says a September RBNZ hike is effectively certain and that the central bank will signal further tightening until the cash rate reaches or exceeds neutral; RBNZ’s published implied peak is about 3.5%. BNZ’s baseline is 25bps hikes at every meeting, taking the cash rate to 4.0% by May 2027. Downside risks include a sharper slowdown from a potential El Niño-driven recession, election-related delayed rebound and a broader global asset-price correction; upside risk is structurally persistent inflation that may ignore policy moves. BNZ cites RBNZ’s July wording that policy “may still need to further reduce monetary stimulus” and expects inflation to remain above target through mid-2027, forecasting Sep-quarter YoY CPI at 3.7% versus RBNZ’s 3.3%.

【ASB: RBNZ September hike near-certain; peak rate likely slightly below market pricing】ASB Bank says markets have almost fully priced a 25bp RBNZ hike, leaving limited scope for a hawkish surprise. ASB still expects at least one more rate increase by year-end, with a terminal rate around 3.3%, slightly below current market pricing. If realised, that could prompt modest dovish re-pricing in front-end NZ yields and weigh on the NZD. ASB notes tightening financial conditions—including a stronger trade-weighted NZD and higher swap rates—that the RBNZ is likely to cite, reducing the case for an especially hawkish statement. With two-way risks to medium-term inflation, money and rates markets will remain highly sensitive to NZ data in the months ahead regardless of Wednesday's outcome.

【UBS's Fang Jinchong: Big internet firms' profit forecasts cut; favors cloud, large-model firms and online gaming】UBS China internet research head Fang Jinchong said at a Shenzhen briefing that the China internet sector is down about 20% YTD; offshore investors have moved from underweight toward neutral but remain cautious on H2 macro and cash flow. He estimates aggregate profit expectations for major internet incumbents have fallen from roughly 680bn yuan at the start of the year to about 600bn yuan in August, driven by higher AI spending, user-acquisition promotions and increased R&D. He said AI has materially reduced production costs in advertising and short-form dramas but so far shows limited revenue conversion. On US–China AI, he estimates the model-capability gap has narrowed to about 3–6 months: China leads on applications and ecosystem, the US on base models and hardware. Valuation dispersion between large and small firms reflects the industry cycle, with pricing power currently concentrated upstream but likely to shift back to downstream players with users and scenarios as upstream capacity is released over coming years. He favors cloud vendors, large-model companies and online gaming.

【ING: RBNZ likely to hike in September but markets’ aggressive tightening bets face high bar】ING expects the RBNZ to raise the official cash rate (OCR) 25bps to 2.75% on Sept. 2. At July’s hike the RBNZ said it may still need to withdraw further monetary stimulus. In its May forecasts—based on higher oil assumptions—the bank signalled rates could reach 3.0% by year-end and remain around that level through 2027. Current market pricing tracks the RBNZ’s 2026 outlook but is more hawkish for 2027 despite softer energy prices. A September hike is fully priced and markets expect one more move before year-end; OIS curves imply about 50bps more tightening, taking rates to ~3.50% by mid-2027. ING sees dovish risk ahead of the meeting and judges the RBNZ faces a high threshold to validate the market’s aggressive tightening expectations.

【李飛飛團隊成立的World Labs釋出新一代世界模型Atlas】人工智慧公司World Labs宣佈推出新一代“世界模型”Atlas。公司稱，Atlas是世界上第一個多模態世界模型，能夠以畫素級精確的相機控制生成影象和影片幀，並將其在 3D 中重建。 李飛飛發文表示，團隊今天實現了一個重大里程碑。她表示，Atlas能夠生成具有畫素級精確相機控制的幀，從僅一張輸入影象重建大型場景，透過重新構圖影片來模擬時空，從一張或多張輸入影象原生輸出3D空間，將多個姿態影象組合成一致的3D世界，以及更多功能。這是有史以來最佳的相機條件世界模型，為從VFX到機器人學的眾多潛在應用場景開啟了大門。 World Labs由著名AI科學家、斯坦福大學教授李飛飛參與創立，公司此前已推出3D世界生成產品Marble。

【國海證券：推薦半導體制造、裝置、材料以及國產算力】國海證券研報表示，結合英偉達業績會指引及產業鏈跟蹤，AI算力建設對於電子製造資源的擠佔效應仍在蔓延中，晶圓代工、儲存、PCB、被動元件、模擬晶片等多個環節的景氣度持續走高，近期MLCC、PCB環節的價格再度大幅上調，展望2027年“漲價鏈”依然是有較強業績支撐的高勝率方向。與此同時，一方面以“韜定律”為象徵的科技自立自強、產業鏈自主可控有望成為近期市場主旋律；另一方面，結合中芯國際2026年二季度少數股東權益的大幅改善以及以華為昇騰為代表的算力卡明年快速增長的預期，國產算力產業鏈2027年的業績彈性有望彰顯，繼續推薦半導體制造、裝置、材料以及國產算力。

【今年前7個月我國對埃及進出口增長18.7%】近年來，我國對埃及進出口值持續保持兩位數增長。據海關統計，今年前7個月，我國對埃及進出口951.9億元，同比增長18.7%；其中，出口增長17.5%，進口大幅增長49.4%。從進口商品結構來看，我國自埃及進口農產品提速明顯。今年前7個月，我國進口埃及農產品同比增長82.6%，佔同期我國自埃及進口總值的41.7%。冷凍草莓、亞麻進口量分別佔到我國同類產品進口總量的96.7%、7.7%。目前，埃及已是我國冷凍草莓進口第一大來源地、亞麻進口第三大來源地。同期，進口埃及金屬礦及礦砂增長12.7%；進口未鍛軋銅及銅材增長139.4%。從主要出口商品來看，今年前7個月，我國對埃及出口機電產品515.3億元，同比增長23.9%，佔同期我國對埃及出口總值的56.9%。

【Huatai Securities flags lithium-battery price-up cycle】Huatai Securities said Xinluo Lithium Battery released September production schedules showing sample firms’ battery output at 211.3 GWh in September, up 6.3% MoM; cathode 249 kt, up 5.5% MoM; anode 218 kt, up 4.1% MoM; separator 2.31 bln sq m, up 1.9% MoM; electrolyte 147 kt, up 3.5% MoM. All five segments hit year-to-date highs, reflecting a continued seasonal uptick. Domestic energy-storage tendering and installations are recovering and European vehicle electrification is accelerating; August saw wider price increases across battery segments. Combined with year-end export tax rebate-driven export pushes and the energy-storage grid-connection season, Huatai expects Q4 production to remain elevated. Monitor the lithium-battery price-up cycle and technology trends: sodium batteries scaling from pilot to mass production and commercialization of solid-state batteries.

【接棒庫克，蘋果新任CEO特努斯發全員信為新品釋出預熱】9月2日，蘋果新任CEO約翰·特努斯（John Ternus）釋出就任後首封全員信，他在信中盛讚公司強大的產品儲備，並預熱了將於下週舉行的新品釋出會。特努斯表示，對此後的發展充滿期待，“包括那些正在研發中的重磅產品，以及我們還未曾設想但將共同構思並創造的產品。”他在信中同時向蒂姆・庫克致謝，感謝他在此次交接期間分享了豐富的知識和經驗，以及其多年來為蘋果公司所做的貢獻。庫克將繼續擔任蘋果公司執行董事長。

Australian Stock Extend Slide, Notch 1-Month Trough — Australian shares slumped 118 points or 1.3% to 8,950 in early Wednesday trade, marking a third straight session of decline and the lowest level in a month. Overnight losses on Wall Street pressured sentiment, with surging bond yields and higher oil prices stoked inflation and rate-hike fears. Locally, caution mounted ahead of Q2 GDP data due later today, with growth expected to stay sluggish after last quarter’s weakest pace in a year. Meanwhile, July trade figures are also due Thursday following June’s export surge and subdued imports. Losses were broad, led by commercial services, non-energy minerals, healthcare, and consumer stocks. Heavyweights BHP Group (-2.8%) and Rio Tinto (-1.3%) dragged, alongside Northern Star Resources (-4.7%), Evolution Mining (-4.2%), and Pro Medicus (-3.6%). Meanwhile, the big four banks eased modestly. Energy names bucked the trend, with Woodside Energy up 2.0% and Santos climbing 1.3%, helping cap the overall decline.

【特朗普石油協議重塑委內瑞拉油田版圖 多名受制裁運營商出局】據報道，美國政府開發委內瑞拉17個油田的協議，將取代一批與前領導人尼古拉斯·馬杜羅有關聯的運營商，從而拆解幫助加拉加斯在多年美國製裁下持續向亞洲出口原油的部分商業網路。據知情人士透露，一名哥倫比亞商人、馬杜羅妻子的親屬等，此前均獲得過開發其中部分油田的合同，而這些人士都受到美國財政部制裁。如今，臨時總統德爾西·羅德里格斯已將這些油田重新分配。委內瑞拉政府正把這些油田交給美國與North American Blue Energy Partners（NABEP）的合作實體，該公司由Alejandro Betancourt經營。這位委內瑞拉商人一直協助特朗普政府吸引規模較小的美國獨立石油企業進入這個南美國家。

【UChicago professor warns Bessent Iran 'economic D‑day' risks military escalation】Robert Pape, a University of Chicago scholar of air power, blockades and sanctions, criticized U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent’s “economic D‑day” campaign against Iran as a dangerous escalation trap unlikely to compel Tehran and liable to draw the U.S. into deeper military conflict. Pape said such measures have not won major wars or toppled governments and warned that tightening sanctions on Iran and its trading partners could provoke retaliatory moves that force Washington to escalate. "This will lead to another escalation trap," he said.

【IPO關鍵時刻，易慕峰CAR-T臨床受試者死亡，回應稱已配合評估調查】胃癌患者化療效果良好，卻被“創新藥”推向死亡？就在mRNA癌症疫苗傳來重大利好之際，作為當下另一熱門抗癌技術CAR-T卻陷入“高危時刻”。近日，程女士向記者披露了一則醫療死亡事件，其丈夫佔某（化名，49歲）因罹患胃癌，在上海長海醫院接受治療後，原本病情穩定。然而，在主治醫生的推薦下，佔某加入了易慕峰生物科技股份有限公司（以下稱“易慕峰生物”）一項名為IMC002的CAR-T細胞臨床試驗。令人遺憾的是，就在輸注試驗藥物當天數小時後，佔某突發雙側硬膜下血腫、腦疝，被迫接受開顱手術，最終於一個多月後不幸離世。雖然易慕峰在發給記者的回應中稱“已配合倫理評估、依法配合調查，補償以法定責任認定為前提，不做預先判斷”。但在CAR-T從血液瘤走向實體瘤的關鍵視窗，一例“化療沒事、回輸當日出事”的死亡，已不只是醫患糾紛，而是一次拷問實體瘤CAR-T圍輸注安全鏈的樣本。對此，易慕峰生物方面向藍鯨新聞回覆稱：“關於事件責任認定，相關事實應當在法定程式下予以公正釐清。我司將全力配合各方依法開展的調查評估工作，尊重獨立調查與評估得出的正式結論，不做預先判斷。”（藍鯨新聞）

【王清憲在合肥、馬鞍山市調研房地產發展工作時強調 以“四好”建設加快房地產轉型升級】8月31日至9月1日，安徽省省長王清憲在合肥、馬鞍山市調研房地產發展工作。他強調，要深刻把握房地產市場供求關係新變化，以系統思維最佳化要素資源配置，加力實施城市更新，統籌推進好房子、好小區、好社群、好城區建設，加快房地產轉型升級，增強城市高質量發展新動能。調研中，王清憲強調，要立足房地產市場發展新形勢，統籌盤活存量、做優增量、提高質量，加強投資與消費、科技與產業、空間與人才整體謀劃，強化運營模式系統設計，在多要素組合中探索房地產發展新模式。要順應人民群眾對美好生活的嚮往，更好滿足群眾剛性和多元化改善性住房需求，以好房子為切入口推進“四好”建設，持續提升城市功能品質活力。要進一步完善金融、財稅、土地等協同保障機制，打通建設、運營、服務等鏈條，激發民間投資活力，推動房地產高質量發展。

【NEA meeting on new-type power grid calls for faster approval and build-out of major transmission corridors】On Sept 1 the National Energy Administration said China’s new-type power grid will link upstream renewable generation with downstream industrial and residential demand, creating strong spillovers and requiring large-scale investment that supports near-term investment and long-term structural adjustment. The NEA instructed authorities to speed approval and construction of major grid projects including transmission corridors, strengthen overall coordination of new-grid development, and step up policy support and implementation.

【美國稱週一有1700萬桶原油透過霍爾木茲海峽】美國能源部長克里斯·賴特在前往委內瑞拉的途中告訴記者，週一有1700萬桶石油透過了霍爾木茲海峽。據美國能源部一位發言人稱，這是自衝突爆發以來最大的數字。發言人表示，另有400萬至500萬桶原油透過管道繞過海峽，使週一的原油運輸量超過了戰前水平。賴特表示，目前平均每天為800萬桶。

【摩根大通：韓國散戶投資者短期內不太可能成為股票的主要買家】摩根大通表示，受市場情緒低迷，疊加槓桿型交易所交易基金（ETF）大機率持續資金流出的影響，短期韓國散戶投資者不太可能大規模買入股票。分析師拉吉夫・巴特拉、米克索・達斯等人在研報中寫道：企業回購已經成為韓國本土股票又一類新增買方，同時純多頭基金的買入力度也開始回升。新興市場投資者與全球投資者仍有增配空間；其中新興市場投資者目前對韓國市場顯著低配，且不再受投資契約條款約束。二季度純多頭投資者最大的變化是，大幅削減韓國及中國臺灣地區科技板塊倉位，主要受個股 10% 持倉上限規則限制。市場對 AI 交易行情的擔憂有所升溫，體現為投資者普遍調降科技板塊整體配置。目前純多頭投資者重點超配領域：中國電動車板塊（寧德時代為亞洲超配比例最高的個股）、消費板塊、印度銀行業，以及韓國的控股集團與銀行。
【三孚股份成立石英玻璃製品新公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，唐山三孚石英玻璃製品有限公司成立，經營範圍包含技術玻璃製品銷售；非金屬礦及製品銷售；計算機軟硬體及輔助裝置批發等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由三孚股份全資持股。

Japanese Shares Drop on Rallying Bond Yields, Oil Prices — The Nikkei 225 Index dropped 2.5% to below 64,600 while the broader Topix Index fell 1.6% to 4,115 on Wednesday, with the Nikkei hitting four-week lows as surging global bond yields and oil prices weighed heavily on equities. Oil prices climbed for a third consecutive session amid escalating hostilities between the US and Iran, heightening inflationary risks and driving global bond yields higher. Japan’s 10-year government bond yield reached 3% for the first time since 1996, also supported by growing expectations for a Bank of Japan interest rate hike this month. Tech and AI-related stocks led the decline, with notable losses from Kioxia Holdings (-1.1%), Advantest (-2.3%), Fujikura (-1.4%), Tokyo Electron (-4.6%) and SoftBank Group (-4.6%). Financial, consumer and industrial stocks also recorded sharp declines.
Japan's TOPIX fell 2%.

【國家能源局召開新型電網建設工作部署會】9月1日，國家能源局召開新型電網建設工作部署會。國家能源局黨組書記、局長王宏志出席會議並講話。會議強調，“十五五”期間，我國電力需求仍將保持年均5%左右的增長，新能源佔比進一步提高，高階產業對綠色高質量電能需求穩步增長，新模式新業態加速湧現，核心技術競爭加劇，對新型電網建設提出更高要求。新型電網建設是新架構、新技術、新服務的深刻變革，必須統籌謀劃、系統施策。一是著力夯實基礎設施長板，構建提升大電網安全穩定水平、充分發揮配電網公共平臺作用、促進智慧微電網靈活多元互動的主配微協同電網新架構。二是著力發揮創新引領作用，加快研發應用人工智慧+、柔性構網、智慧調控、長時儲能等電網新技術，發展新質生產力。三是著力加強多元支撐保障，升級新能源高效併網消納、高品質供電、算電協同等新業態友好適配的電網新服務，更好滿足產業發展和人民群眾需求。四是著力守牢安全執行底線，確保大電網安全穩定執行，加強工程安全質量管理，提升電網防災應急能力，增強安全韌性水平。(國家能源局)

【Nvidia in talks to buy Hugging Face; deal could total $14 bln】Nvidia (NVDA.O) is in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Hugging Face in a deal that could total about $14 bln, sources said. One source said Nvidia could agree as early as this week to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9 bln. The transaction may include an approximately $1 bln employee retention package. Sources cautioned no final agreement has been reached and timing and terms remain subject to change. The deal would be Nvidia’s largest move to date to broaden AI applications and its customer base and would give the company control of a key developer platform for sharing and showcasing AI models.

【U.S. strikes two moored Iranian government tankers】AXIOS reports the U.S. military struck two moored Iranian government tankers on Tuesday as part of a wider set of strikes, U.S. officials said. Officials said this marks the first time Washington has struck Iranian tankers in direct retaliation for alleged Iranian attacks on vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz; previous actions against Iranian tankers had focused on enforcing U.S. maritime restrictions. A U.S. official said the operation is part of a Trump-approved tanker-for-tanker policy intended to further deter attacks on tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The struck tankers were moored in Iranian nearshore waters north of the U.S. maritime blockade line; U.S. drones fired missiles that hit engine rooms. U.S. officials said additional targets included Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps air defenses, radar, mine-laying facilities, communications sites, anti-ship cruise missile launchers and attack-drone launch platforms.
【伊朗一婚禮因美軍襲擊5死50傷】當地時間9月1日晚，美軍襲擊伊朗多地。據伊朗媒體報道，在伊朗南部霍爾木茲甘省錫裡克地區一處村莊，一處正在舉行婚禮的民房被美軍彈片擊中。目前死亡人數已升至5人，其中包括一名兒童，此外還有包括35名重傷員在內的大約50人受傷。死傷人數可能還將進一步上升。

【深圳8月住宅成交創近5年同期新高 政策組合拳預熱“金九”】記者注意到，8月份深圳房地產市場整體呈現“淡季不淡”的盤整態勢。資料顯示，上月深圳一、二手住宅網籤量同比均保持正增長，整體成交創下2022年以來同期新高。同時，前線門店實際簽約量逆勢走高。市場分析認為，在剛需與學區房置業群體逐漸活躍的背景下，疊加近期多項重磅樓市政策落地釋放的積極訊號，深圳樓市“金九”行情或已提前啟動。網籤資料顯示，8月深圳新房成交3467套，環比下降23%；二手房成交5317套，環比下降9.3%。 值得一提的是，深圳8月住宅整體成交創2022年以來同期新高。深圳中原研究中心資料顯示，8月深圳一、二手住宅成交6864套，環比下滑17.5%，同比上升8.5%，為2022年以來同期新高。其中，一手住宅（預現售）網籤2589套，環比下滑26.6%，同比上升20.4%，為2023年以來最高；二手住宅過戶4275套，環比下降10.8，同比上升2.4%，為2021年以來最高。

【美國依據新 “以油輪還油輪” 政策打擊伊朗油輪】據報道，美國官員稱，美軍在週二的一輪打擊行動中襲擊了兩艘伊朗政府所屬油輪。這是美軍首次針對伊朗油輪實施打擊，以此報復伊朗在霍爾木茲海峽襲擊商船，而非為阻止油輪違反海上封鎖。一名美國官員表示，該行動是特朗普總統批准的全新 “以油輪還油輪” 政策的一部分，意在進一步威懾伊朗，制止其襲擊途經該海峽的油輪。

【日本央行植田和男：將在考量物價上行風險的前提下制定政策】日本央行行長植田和男表示，他將在充分考慮物價上行風險的基礎上制定貨幣政策，此番言論或將進一步加劇市場對本月下旬政策會議可能加息的猜測。在北卡羅來納州阿什維爾舉辦的G20財長與央行行長會議結束後，植田和男向記者表示，日本央行會像歷次會議一樣，在下一次會議上就貨幣政策展開充分討論。針對市場高漲的9月加息預期，植田和男拒絕作出評價，但他稱經濟資料與央行的展望保持一致，這一關鍵表述暗示日本央行有望繼續推進加息。本週美國財政部長斯科特・貝森特加大呼籲，要求日本央行採取恰當政策行動，進一步推升市場對日本央行即將行動的預期，此後植田和男發表了上述言論。隔夜指數互換資料顯示，9月加息的機率約為99%。

【今年北交所新股發行節奏顯著提速】二級市場層面，今年北交所新股發行節奏顯著提速，前8個月新股申購數量超越2024、2025兩年全年總和。依託無市值底倉、按比例配售的制度優勢，板塊打新熱度居高不下，疊加新股上市後的高賺錢效應，增量資金持續入場，但行情分化愈發明顯，年內新股首日漲幅最高超600%，部分傳統製造業新股漲幅僅20%至30%。南開大學金融發展研究院院長田利輝分析指出，市場行情正從資金炒作轉向基本面定價，業績兌現能力、技術壁壘與賽道景氣度，成為資金擇股的核心標準。

【聚焦專精特新、服務科創小微，是北交所五年發展鮮明的核心底色】自設立以來，北交所堅守差異化發展定位，深耕創新型中小企業服務賽道，重點吸納掌握核心技術、紮根細分賽道的優質企業登陸資本市場。有效填補了中小科創企業的直接融資空白，為細分領域硬核科技企業的成長壯大，提供了關鍵的資本支撐。北交所2026年半年報資料顯示：板塊上市公司上半年合計營收1385.66億元，同比增長15.11%；歸母淨利潤117.83億元，同比增長17.58%。超八成企業實現盈利，盈利面達83.19%；七成企業營收同比上行，增長基本面紮實穩固。其中次新股表現格外亮眼，淨利潤增速達到59%，大幅跑贏板塊平均水平，為市場注入強勁的增量活力。從行業維度觀察，戰略性新興產業成為上半年北交所上市公司業績增長的重要支柱。部分企業乘著下游需求回暖、產品價格上行的東風，盈利能力得到明顯修復提升；新一代資訊科技產業同樣保持較快增速，伴隨人工智慧相關需求加速釋放，板塊內企業歸母淨利潤同比增長近15%。（央視）

【設立五週年，北交所含“新”量不斷提升】2021年9月2日，北京證券交易所正式宣佈設立，次日完成註冊登記，並於當年11月15日揭牌開市。五年來，北交所經歷了初期改革“試驗田”的探索階段，逐步成長為聚焦創新型、專精特新中小企業的核心服務陣地，市場規模、投資者體量、交易活躍度實現跨越式增長，精準服務中小科創企業的市場定位愈發鮮明。立足新起點，在市場體量持續擴容、企業基本面穩步向好的背景下，北交所該如何補齊市場短板、暢通投融資雙向迴圈，真正打通創新型中小企業長效融資發展通道？從開市之初的81家企業，到如今擴容至339家；合格投資者跨過千萬門檻、成交規模實現量級躍升。五年時間，北交所完成了一次看得見的規模跨越。而在各項亮眼增長資料之下，南開大學金融發展研究院院長田利輝觀察，一組組增長的資料背後，更深層的變化正在發生，這塊資本市場改革“試驗田”，正加速成長為多層次資本市場的關鍵一環。 （央視新聞）
【日本央行行長植田和男：密切關注外匯波動】日本央行行長植田和男稱，不會單獨關注外匯，在制定政策時會比以往更強烈地對外匯波動作出反應。密切關注外匯波動，外匯波動是價格前景的風險因素之一。

【中金：開源模型促進生態繁榮 帶動雲廠商、FDE、應用廠商需求提升】中金公司研報指出，開源模型基於高價效比+高智慧水平，獲得海內外使用者的廣泛認可，開源模型呼叫量趨勢性提升。據估算，今年海外開源模型收入將達到百億美元，而2027年全球開源模型呼叫量佔總Token量50%—70%，價值量將達到大模型市場的12%—30%。開源模型促進生態繁榮，帶動雲廠商、FDE、應用廠商需求提升。開源模型整體生態參與方眾多，算力硬體、雲廠商、推理調優平臺、聚合/應用平臺都將參與其中，開源模型的技術進步也將帶動相關參與方的商業化兌現。其中，雲廠商部署開源模型帶來的價值量提升，FDE也在開源模型部署和理解企業工作流需求之間起到重要作用，應用廠商則是在開源模型的推動下提升創新能力和滲透效率，後續隨著應用端TAM的擴大，又會反哺開源/閉源模型產業鏈的發展。

【中消協釋出提示：別讓AI服務誤導消費決策】近日，中國消費者協會發布人工智慧服務消費提示，提醒廣大消費者理性認識通用生成式人工智慧的資訊輔助和參考屬性，對涉及價格費用、合同條款、售後服務、法律責任等重要消費資訊，不宜僅依據人工智慧生成內容作出決定，應透過經營者官方渠道、合同文字、監管部門及其他權威渠道進行核實確認。

Japan Monetary Base Posts Sharpest Fall Since 2007 — Japan’s monetary base contracted by 15.7% year-on-year in August 2026, marking the sharpest decline since March 2007 and exceeding market estimates for a 13.5% decline. The latest reading also accelerated from a 13.8% decline in July, driven by a 18.9% drop in current account balances held at the Bank of Japan, following a 16.6% fall in July, while banknotes in circulation fell 2.0% (1.9%) and coins in circulation eased 1.2% (1.1%). On an average outstanding basis, the monetary base stood at ¥543.0 trillion in August, down from ¥554.9 trillion in July.

US Futures Flat After Downbeat Session — US stock futures stabilized on Wednesday after the major averages posted another losing session, pressured by rising bond yields and oil prices that heightened concerns over inflation and interest rate hikes. In regular trading on Tuesday, the Dow fell 0.79%, the S&P 500 declined 0.71% and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 1.03%, with all three benchmarks extending their losing streak to a third session. Seven of the 11 S&P sectors finished lower, led by declines in consumer discretionary, industrials and materials. The moves came as the global bond selloff intensified, pushing the US 10-year Treasury yield to its highest level since early 2025. Oil prices also surged amid escalating hostilities between the US and Iran, raising the risk of further disruptions to energy flows from the Middle East. Investors now await ADP private payrolls data and the Fed’s Beige Book, along with earnings reports from Broadcom, Hewlett Packard and Snowflake, among others.

【美國長債收益率重返貝森特出手前水平 市場說光靠擴大回購不夠】美國最長天期的政府債券收益率攀升，重返上個月財政部長斯科特·貝森特震撼市場、宣佈擴大債券回購計劃以遏止收益率上揚之前的水準。這項策略一度奏效，但席捲全球市場的債券拋售潮隨後再度推高美國政府的借貸成本。到了週二，30年期國債收益率升至5.27%，回到貝森特8月19日宣佈該舉措前不久的水平相同。作為各類貸款成本重要基準的10年期國債收益率，比當時高出10個基點以上，來到約4.8%。這些走勢傳達出全球最大債券市場發出的明確訊號：要安撫那些憂心國債激增和通脹持續居高不下的投資者，光靠財政部臨時調整債券回購計劃還不夠。“美債收益率即使明顯回落，也始終守不住，”美國銀行利率策略主管Mark Cabana表示。“投資者若要把資金鎖定在如此長的期限，就會要求最高的風險補償。”

【美軍稱完成對伊朗的新一輪打擊】美軍中央司令部1日在社交媒體釋出訊息說，美軍已完成對伊朗軍事目標的新一輪打擊，目標包括伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊的防空陣地、雷達系統、海事資產與設施、佈雷能力以及通訊站點。 美軍於美東時間1日12時開始對伊朗境內的伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊目標發動新一輪打擊。美國總統特朗普隨後在社交媒體發文稱，美軍此次打擊“規模大、威力強”，是對伊朗企圖在霍爾木茲海峽佈設水雷以及向美國在約旦的軍事基地發射8枚導彈的報復行動。如果伊朗對此次打擊進行報復，美國將再次進行“更猛烈、更高階別”的打擊。 伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊1日宣佈已開始回應美方當天的襲擊，並稱擊落一架美軍MQ-9無人機。約旦武裝部隊2日凌晨發表宣告說，約旦防空系統在過去數小時內攔截了10枚來自伊朗的彈道導彈，另有3枚彈道導彈落在偏遠地區。 美國駐約旦、卡達、巴林和沙烏地阿拉伯等中東國家的使館已在其官網釋出安全警報，稱中東地區局勢緊張且存在“局勢意外升級的風險”，要求目前身處中東地區的美國公民保持謹慎和警惕，並做好航班取消、領空臨時關閉以及出行可能受阻的準備。(新華社)

【樓市新政密集落地 為“金九銀十”旺季蓄力】9月，樓市進入傳統的“金九銀十”旺季。隨著多個城市的樓市新政密集落地，市場熱度有望攀升。“多地透過調整限購政策、貸款首付比例，進一步釋放了購房的潛力。同時，多地提高住房公積金貸款額度，並藉助包括住房公積金貸款貼息、賣舊買新補貼等在內的多項補貼，降低了購房的成本。”廣東省住房政策研究中心首席研究員李宇嘉向證券時報記者表示，從政策出臺節奏來看，北京、上海出臺政策後，成都、西安等地跟進，形成一線、二線城市聯動，持續跟進的接力效應向市場傳遞積極訊號，提振市場信心與預期。有業內人士表示，根據以往經驗，政策釋出後通常在落地1至2個月後進入集中釋放期，市場成交量在短期回升的確定性較強。多重政策紅利已經為樓市點燃預熱引擎，為“金九銀十”這一樓市傳統旺季蓄力，市場有望迎來一輪成交量的集中釋放，特別是一線樓市有望迎來一波成交量回暖行情，但行情分化、穩健修復將成為主線。

【伊朗稱襲擊約旦哈桑王子空軍基地 摧毀多架無人機】當地時間2日凌晨，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊發表宣告稱，為報復美軍行為，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊航空航天部隊對位於約旦的哈桑王子空軍基地發動攻擊，摧毀了多架RQ-4和MQ-9無人機，並打死了多名飛行員和機組人員，美軍的多個技術設施也遭到破壞。

【併購重組市場活躍度穩步提升 交易邏輯轉向產業價值整合】A股併購重組市場活躍度穩步提升。權威資料顯示，今年前7個月，A股市場披露資產重組方案1425單，其中重大資產重組78單。在業內人士看來，此輪併購重組市場回暖，在交易數量提升的同時，交易邏輯逐步轉向產業價值整合，交易質量導向顯著增強，推動資本市場與產業升級形成正向迴圈。從併購交易目的看，今年以來超過六成交易圍繞主業橫向整合、產業鏈縱向補鏈展開。以高階裝備、生物醫藥、新能源等為代表的先進製造產業併購保持活躍，企業透過併購重組實現產業鏈上下游整合，完善產業矩陣，打造新的業績增長曲線。（上證報）

【Peru severs diplomatic ties with Iran】Peru’s foreign ministry said on Sept 1 it has severed diplomatic relations with Iran and notified Tehran by diplomatic note delivered through Iran’s embassy in Ecuador.

【Putin says Ukraine's 40-day attacks caused damage equal to about 1% of Russian GDP】Putin said Ukraine's 40-day campaign ordered by Zelensky inflicted damage on Russia equal to about 1% of GDP, based on preliminary estimates. He said since June roughly 100 Russian vessels have been damaged, about 40 in the first two weeks, and that only about 10% of damaged refinery facilities remain to be repaired. He did not comment on strikes against Wildberries and Ozon warehouses; those attacks have already caused billions of dollars of damage to Russia's logistics network. Zelensky has threatened large-scale drone deployments to effectively close Russian commercial airspace; Putin said Russia would find a way to respond if that occurs.
【秘魯宣佈與伊朗斷絕外交關係】當地時間9月1日，秘魯外交部宣佈與伊朗斷絕外交關係，並表示這一決定已透過伊朗駐厄瓜多大使館以外交照會方式通知伊朗。（央視新聞）

【房車露營等需求旺盛 汽車後市場潛力將獲充分挖掘】汽車後市場的消費潛力有望被進一步挖掘。《關於推動商品消費擴容升級的實施意見》（下稱“意見”）提出，深入推進汽車流通消費改革試點，加快破除汽車流通消費領域不合理限制性措施，創新汽車使用管理模式，全鏈條擴大汽車消費。培育壯大汽車後市場，支援發展汽車改裝、維修保養、賽事運動、房車露營，建立傳統經典車認定和管理制度。記者近日採訪獲悉，汽車後市場消費作為圍繞汽車使用而產生的全週期性消費，對拉動居民消費升級、激發經營主體活力、推動汽車產業轉型發揮著重要作用：一方面，大量車輛進入維修保養等高頻週期，剛性服務需求持續釋放；另一方面，個性化需求快速增長，汽車文化消費開始發力，汽車後市場的細分賽道開始起勢。（上海證券報）

【韓國8月通脹加速 強化央行保持緊縮立場的前景】韓國8月通脹率加速程度低於預期，但核心價格漲幅創三年多來最快，這增強了韓國央行維持緊縮政策的理由。韓國資料統計部門週三公佈的資料顯示，8月消費價格指數同比上漲3.1%，高於7月的2.8%。調查中值預期為上升3.2%。剔除波動較大的食品和能源價格後的核心通脹率從7月的2.6%加速至3.4%，為2023年5月以來最快增速。這表明除了能源成本上漲的影響外，潛在的價格壓力依然持續存在。這些資料可能會令韓國央行對通脹問題保持警惕，儘管總體通脹率受到一些一次性因素的影響。財政部估計去年同期的手機話費折扣給通脹資料帶來影響。

Brent Extends Gains on Escalating US-Iran Attacks — Brent crude climbed above $95 per barrel on Wednesday, rising for a third consecutive session to its highest level in nearly six weeks as escalating hostilities between the US and Iran heightened concerns over further disruptions to energy flows from the Middle East. The US military launched fresh strikes against Iranian targets around the Strait of Hormuz, which President Donald Trump said were retaliation for Tehran’s attempts to lay mines in the waterway and for an earlier attack on a US military base. Trump also threatened a significantly larger response should Tehran retaliate. Iran said it had already responded by targeting US bases in the region and firing missiles toward Jordan. Meanwhile, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Iran’s bankruptcy is in the “acceleration phase,” while noting that 17 million barrels of crude passed through Hormuz on Monday, suggesting Tehran does not have control of the strategic waterway.

【派發2500多億元“紅包” 上市銀行中期分紅陣營擴大】隨著2026年上市銀行半年報季收官，“中期分紅”成為最受市場關注的關鍵詞。截至8月底，各型別銀行相繼披露中期分紅計劃，合計擬派發現金紅利超過2500億元，參與中期分紅的A股銀行數量已從去年的24家擴大至31家。從結構特徵看，國有大行分紅總量最大；股份制銀行平均分紅比例相對較高，分紅力度較為突出；城商行整體分紅比例略低，呈現一定的梯度差異。（上海證券報）

South Korea Inflation Rate Accelerates in August — South Korea’s annual inflation rate rose to 3.1% in August 2026 from 2.8% in the previous month. The latest reading was below market expectations of 3.2%, though it climbed further above the central bank’s 2% target. Transport inflation remained elevated at 7.2%, although it eased from 7.7% in July, as gasoline and diesel prices accelerated, while communication costs surged 16.6% (vs 0.5%). Inflation also increased for recreation and culture (4.9% vs 5.5%), housing and utilities (1.9% vs 1.8%), and restaurants and hotels (2.8% vs 2.8%). By contrast, food and non-alcoholic beverages prices fell 0.5% (vs 0.9%), with fresh food prices dropping 6.7%. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose by 0.2% in July, falling short of market estimates for a 0.3% gain but rebounding from a 0.2% decline in the preceding period.

【試點四年蓄勢“轉正” 券商綜合賬戶管理新規徵求意見】近日，中國證券業協會組織起草《證券公司客戶綜合賬戶管理指引（徵求意見稿）》（下稱《指引》），向行業公開徵求意見，標誌著始於2021年的賬戶管理功能最佳化試點正向全行業常規化邁進。《指引》共計47條，對綜合賬戶管理、同名賬戶資金劃轉、分類子賬戶管理等作出系統性規範，引導證券公司合規、審慎、有序地開展綜合賬戶服務。受訪人士認為，綜合賬戶的最大突破在於將客戶分散於普通、信用、期權等不同賬戶中的資金與資產，整合為一個統一的賬戶檢視和排程體系。長期來看，綜合賬戶服務將成為券商數字化經營和財富管理轉型的基礎工程，決定未來5到10年零售與機構業務的核心競爭力。（上海證券報）

【U.S. refiners poised for a boom】The S&P 500 Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing Index has climbed 108% over the past 12 months to about 3,250, near record highs. The index tracks large U.S. refiners, marketers and transporters. This is the biggest 12-month gain since the post-2020 recovery; only 2013 and 2005 produced comparable 30-year performances. Refining and marketing stocks are up 175% since April 2025, and markets are positioning for a strong upswing in U.S. refining.
【個人持有ETF比例半年躍升至43%】隨著2026年基金中期報告披露完畢，ETF持有人結構浮出水面。從總體來看，過去半年來，個人投資者持有ETF的比例大幅提升。Choice資料顯示，截至6月底，個人投資者持有ETF份額從2025年底的1.08萬億份增至1.25萬億份，個人投資者的持有比例從33.07%增至43.01%。（上海證券報）

【不愛“綠鞋”愛“入通” 港股IPO湧現新潮流】“不穿綠鞋，首日入通”在A+H上市公司中越來越受到歡迎，並逐漸成為一股潮流。記者初步統計發現，今年以來，濱化股份、普源精電、沃爾核材、國恩科技、兆威機電、美格智慧、廣合科技、國民技術等多家公司在發行H時，選擇不設綠鞋機制，並實現首日納入港股通。相比之下，去年僅有吉宏股份一家公司選擇了該機制。這一現象的背後，是A股公司赴港上市對南向資金越來越重視。隨著南向資金佔港股總交易量比重顯著上升，南向資金對港股的邊際定價權明顯增強。多位接受採訪的人士認為，引入綠鞋機制，還是選擇首日納入港股通，實際上是港股發行人和承銷團在流通盤、穩價需求、投資者結構與後續交易活躍度之間進行的一種權衡動作。（上海證券報）

【中方敦促早日實現烏克蘭危機的政治解決 】中國常駐聯合國副代表孫磊1日在聯大審議烏克蘭問題時發言，敦促早日實現危機的政治解決。 孫磊說，烏克蘭問題仍在延宕。自聯大上次討論烏克蘭問題以來，地面形勢非但沒有得到緩和反而愈演愈烈，襲擊和平民傷亡事件頻繁發生，戰事還對第三方國家造成嚴重負面影響，令人深感憂慮和痛心。中方呼籲當事方和國際社會共同努力，推動早日實現停火止戰、危機政治解決。中方敦促停止任何針對平民的襲擊，呼籲當事方保持冷靜剋制，嚴格遵守國際人道法，保護平民和民用基礎設施安全，避免傷及第三方平民和民用資產，為早日實現和平爭取希望。
【位元組新一代AI手機豆包手機即將上市】中興通訊終端事業部總裁倪飛在社交平臺表示， 努比亞NaviX Ultra於9月1日正式入網。他表示，從大模型備案到終端入網，已率先走完了智慧體手機的合規流程，全球首款AI智慧體手機，本月將正式上市。記者獲悉，這款手機為中興通訊與位元組跳動聯合研發。 (科創板日報)

【外部因素擾動港股反彈程序 機構建議圍繞基本面佈局】在美聯儲主席釋放鷹派訊號、長端美債收益率高企等因素擾動下，港股市場在8月承壓，未能延續7月強勁反彈的態勢，9月1日延續調整態勢。不過從南向資金流向看，8月南向資金再度淨流入逾百億港元，市場並未出現明顯悲觀情緒。在業內人士看來，當前美聯儲加息機率以及美債利率上行風險上升壓制港股估值進一步修復的空間，港股後續走強需要業績驗證或穩增長政策加碼推動盈利預期由區域性上修擴散至整體。對於後市配置，建議圍繞盈利確定性更高或具備獨立催化因素的領域展開佈局，AI應用龍頭、醫藥生物板塊、高股息紅利資產等值得關注。（中國證券報）

【Trump presses refiners to boost output; biofuel blending mandates cited as obstacle】At a closed-door meeting Tuesday, Trump urged US refiners to raise domestic gasoline and diesel output, saying he wants lower pump prices and asking executives how to expand refining capacity. Discussion covered regulatory reform and additional investment. Refining executives said federal biofuel blending mandates, including alternative-fuel quotas, are pushing up retail gasoline prices and questioned the government's record-high blending targets.

【大型IPO專案落地 港股優質資產供給持續擴容】9月首個交易日，港股市場迎來大型IPO專案落地。跨境電商巨頭希音-W正式在港交所主機板掛牌上市，募資規模約132億港元。同日，百度集團正式完成由香港聯交所的第二上市地位向香港聯交所及納斯達克雙重主要上市的轉換。分析人士認為，大型IPO專案接連登陸與雙重主要上市機制持續深化，標誌著港股市場優質資產供給渠道進一步拓寬。隨著頭部科技企業、行業龍頭及中概股迴歸專案陸續推進，港股市場正迎來一波高質量的上市資源擴容。優質資產供給增加，將進一步提升港股對全球資金的吸引力，併為市場流動性改善和估值修復提供支撐。（中國證券報）

【淨息差持續探底 中小銀行直面盈利考驗】0.98%，這是哈爾濱銀行今年上半年的淨息差資料。淨息差是評價商業銀行生息資產收益能力和風險定價能力的關鍵指標，當淨息差絕對水平較低時，銀行的盈利能力面臨嚴峻考驗。事實上，在二季度銀行業整體淨息差企穩回升的大背景下，包括哈爾濱銀行在內的部分中小銀行淨息差水平難言樂觀。這類銀行往往具有負債端成本較高、資產端再投資壓力較大的特點。何時才能看到這些中小銀行的淨息差企穩回升？業內人士尚無明確答案。對此，專家建議，上述中小銀行應從負債端和資產端尋找答案，爭取低成本負債，培育特色產品，取得合理定價能力；同時，在中間業務上多下功夫，增加非息收入規模。（中國證券報）

Australia Manufacturing Contraction Eases — Australia’s Ai Group Industry Index for manufacturing remained in contraction in August, albeit at a softer pace, rising to -16.6 from July’s upwardly revised -19.3. The sector remained under pressure as lower domestic demand, rising input costs, heavier compliance burdens, supply chain challenges, and stronger competition from imports squeezed margins. Upstream industries showed improvement: chemicals increased activity due to new construction projects, despite rising input and material costs, market uncertainty, and staff shortages, while metals also recorded an improvement, concentrated in project-driven work. Downstream, machinery and equipment deteriorated amid lower orders, while food and beverage was the weakest sector, with demand weakened by adverse weather, rising input costs, and supply delays, alongside limited capacity to pass costs on to price-sensitive customers.
【我國科研團隊首次實現高光譜相機實時解析】高光譜成像能透過物質特有的光譜資訊識別材質和成分，是遙感監測、工業檢測等領域的重要技術。近日，北京理工大學科研團隊首創片上光譜計算新方法，將原本依賴大型伺服器完成的光譜解析整合到便攜裝置中，實現高光譜資訊的現場實時處理。相關成果近日發表於國際學術期刊《科學》。

Australia Construction Bounces Back — The Ai Group Industry Index for Australia’s construction sector jumped to -6.9 in August 2026 from a revised -43.8 in the previous month, marking its highest reading since January and signalling a sharp improvement in conditions. However, businesses continued to report uncertainty stemming from taxation changes and the Federal Budget, as well as volatility in energy markets, with some respondents finding it difficult to forecast demand. Cost pressures also remained elevated, with businesses citing higher supplier prices, fuel levies, and raw material and energy costs. Labour shortages continued to constrain activity, particularly due to a lack of skilled trades, difficulties sourcing and retaining staff, and increased competition for workers amid a low-unemployment environment.

Australia Industry Conditions Rebound — Australia’s Industry Index surged to -3.5 in August from a revised -26.2 in the prior month, its highest since February, signaling a sharp rebound in business conditions. Construction and business services led the recovery, buoyed by data centre projects. Activity and sales jumped 31.2 points to -2.2, new orders rose 15.9 points to -14.9, and employment gained 24.9 points to 3.0, all at their strongest since the energy crisis began. Firms reported mixed fortunes: some secured contracts and project wins, while others faced weaker sales and enquiries. Input volumes remained constrained by supply-chain disruptions, elevated costs, and geopolitical uncertainty. Pricing indicators diverged: input prices climbed 10.8 points to 68.0, while sales prices fell 13.1 points to 0.2, leaving a record 67.8-point margin gap. Average wages rose 16.9 points, reflecting annual increases at the start of the new financial year, underscoring persistent labor cost pressures despite headline improvement.

【Apple’s new CEO Ternus set for $58m fiscal‑2027 pay package】Apple told the SEC that John Ternus’ fiscal‑2027 compensation package is valued at about $58m; Tim Cook’s package as executive chairman is about $47m. The filing, submitted on Ternus’ first day in the role, shows Ternus’ annual base salary at $3m and a target stock award of $55m for 2027. In 2026 he will receive pro‑rata RSUs worth roughly $2.5m. Seventy‑five percent of Ternus’ stock award is tied to Apple’s performance versus S&P 500 constituent companies; the remaining 25% are time‑based units that vest semiannually. Cook’s base salary will fall from $3m to $2m and his 2027 target equity award is $45m, with only half of his award performance‑tied to S&P 500 relative performance.

US Crude Oil Inventories Resume Drawdown — US crude oil inventories fell by 2.6 million barrels in the week ending August 28th, according to the American Petroleum Institute (API), following a 4.2 million-barrel increase in the previous week. Commercial crude inventories excluding the SPR have declined by just over 48 million barrels over the past 20 weeks, while total US crude inventories are up 3.1 million barrels year-to-date. Another 3.1 million barrels left the SPR, bringing total reserves to 286.6 million barrels, within the generally accepted operational minimum of 250-300 million barrels. US crude production rose to 13.843 million bpd in the week ending August 21st from 13.830 million bpd, up 461,000 bpd year-on-year. Meanwhile, gasoline inventories increased by 300,000 barrels after falling 3.2 million barrels the previous week, while distillate stocks declined by 300,000 barrels following a 500,000-barrel draw. Cushing inventories rose by 200,000 barrels after increasing by 1 million barrels previously.

【ANTHROPIC releases Fable 5.1 — coding/science gains; 75% cut to re‑call token price; customer cloud hosting option】ANTHROPIC released Fable 5.1, saying the model improves performance on programming and scientific tasks while lowering enterprise operating costs. The model is positioned for long, complex software tasks — including full-application development and code review — and expands scientific capabilities such as experimental design, result simulation and reading complex charts and tables. Enterprise token pricing remains unchanged from Fable 5, but Anthropic cut pricing for re-invoking already-processed context by 75% — a usage segment that can exceed half of tokens in long-text or complex workflows — which Anthropic says should materially lower overall inference costs. Fable 5.1 also upgrades its safety classifier to better detect risky instructions and reduce false positives, targeting safer use in cybersecurity and bio-related applications. Anthropic plans to allow enterprise customers to store strongest-model data on their own cloud infrastructure rather than Anthropic servers, while continuing to apply safety checks.

【US Congress passes stopgap funding bill to avert government shutdown】US Congress passed a stopgap appropriations bill to avert an Oct. 1 government shutdown, funding the government through Dec. 11. The House approved the measure 370-48 after the Senate had already cleared it; the bill has been sent to President Trump and has White House support. Lawmakers have passed none of the 12 annual appropriations for the new fiscal year, requiring this continuing resolution. The measure postpones disputes over Pentagon budget increases and Republican proposals to cut social programs until after the midterm elections. House Republicans also plan to delay consideration of a separate $95bn Iran emergency funding bill, and a proposal to add $350bn to the Pentagon’s base budget has been pushed to the autumn.

Brent Rises to Over 1-Month High — Brent futures rose to $94 per barrel on Tuesday, the highest in over one month, as more strikes in the Middle East prolonged the period of suspended exports from the region. The US launched a new wave of attacks against Iran after both countries exchanged strikes earlier in the week, heightening the conflict even though the US had signaled it would stick to only economic measures against Tehran. Tanker flows were set to drop sharply after reports that GCC nations enabled the export of barrels had allowed for some respite in crude oil and refined goods prices. A greater rebound to crude prices were prevented by major economies tapping on inventory to tame higher import turnover. The US SPR plunged to less than 290 million barrels, the lowest since 1982. On top of that, China significantly cut imports of crude oil and refinery runs in the country were cut by only 1.6 million barrels per day, indicating the cutback in crude consumption despite steady demand for refined product.

Gasoline Extends Gains — US gasoline futures fluctuated strongly around $3.11 per gallon on Tuesday, astraders assessed refining capacity and its implications for fuel-pump prices. EIA data showed the average US regular gasoline price edged down to $4.07 per gallon in the week ending August 31st, despite continued tightness in refined supply, while gasoline inventories for the same week fell 2.536 million barrels. Goldman Sachs has warned of tightness in global refining, with the crack spread near multi-year highs, as Russian refining declined to near multi-year lows and fresh strikes from the U.S. on Iranian targets around the Strait of Hormuz kept transit in the waterway cautious. Strong demand is also supporting prices, with heavy driving expected over Labor Day weekend. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump and Energy Secretary Wright are set to meet US oil refiners on Tuesday to discuss near-term measures regarding refining capacity, which is already operating near full capacity.

Peru Annual Inflation Accelerates Further — The annual inflation rate in Peru's capital, Lima, accelerated to 4.44% in August 2026, marking the fastest pace in nearly three years, up from 4.07% in July. Price pressures have strengthened since March amid a domestic gas crisis, higher global fuel prices, and adverse weather affecting crop yields and fishing. Inflation accelerated for food, rising to 3.9% from 3.5%, and restaurants and hotels (4.3% vs 4.2%), while transport costs surged further by 14.8% after a 14.3% rise. Price growth in housing and utilities also added upward pressure, rising sharply to 3.1% from 1.3%. From the previous month, consumer prices rose 0.07%, easing from a 0.29% rise in the prior month.

European Stocks Drop for 2nd Session — European stocks closed sharply lower for a second session on Tuesday amid persistent concerns that tight financial conditions could hamper economic activity. The Euro STOXX 50 fell 0.9% to 6,365 and the STOXX Europe 600 dropped 0.6% to 647. The US and Iran exchanged more strikes and prolonged the outlook of suspended energy exports from the Persian Gulf, raising fuel prices and inflationary risks. The elevated energy price backdrop had already lifted headline inflation in the Eurozone, per the latest data, consolidating the likelihood of an ECB hike this month. SAP, Prosus, and Adyen dropped between 4% and 2.6%. Industrials also closed lower with Siemens, Schneider, and Rheinmetall dropping around 2.5%. On the other hand, Novartis surged 6.3% as its experimental multiple sclerosis pill succeeded in two late trials.
Apple (AAPL.O) shares rose 2.74% intraday.

CAC 40 Falls on Inflationary Pressures — The CAC 40 fell 0.4% to close at 8,302 on Thursday, reversing early gains and tracking broader weakness in global equities. Rising oil prices amid escalating Middle East tensions added to inflationary pressures, while investors increased bets on further ECB tightening. Higher energy costs and expectations of a Fed hike also pushed global bond yields higher. Eurozone inflation accelerated for a second consecutive month to 3.3% in August, in line with forecasts and the highest since September 2023. Luxury stocks fell, with LVMH down 1.8%, L’Oreal losing 1.4%, Hermes shedding 2.4% and Kering tumbling 2.7%. Industrials also declined, led by Safran (-2.6%) and Thales (-2.1%). Tech stocks tracked losses in Wall Street chipmakers. Colombia Manufacturing PMI Rises to 54.3 — Colombia’s Davivienda Manufacturing PMI rose to 54.3 in August 2026 from 52.7 in July, signaling the strongest improvement in factory activity since October 2025. New orders grew at their fastest pace in more than two-and-a-half years, while production growth accelerated to its strongest since February. Finished goods inventories declined for a sixth consecutive month as firms used stocks to meet demand. Manufacturers increased input purchases and inventories, with purchasing activity reaching its strongest level since data collection began in April 2011. Delivery delays eased despite some earthquake-related disruptions. Input cost inflation fell to its lowest level this year, while output price inflation picked up slightly. Employment rose for a fifth consecutive month, while backlogs declined for a seventh month. Business confidence surged to its highest level since July 2019, supported by optimism over the new government administration and expectations of stronger demand.

Cocoa Futures Hover Near 1-Year High — Cocoa futures traded around $6,600 per tonne, holding close to their highest since September 2025, amid mounting concerns over West African supply. This year’s cocoa crops in top producers Ivory Coast and Ghana have been hit by cloudy weather and limited sunshine, creating conditions favorable for black pod disease and hurting bean quality. The outlook for the upcoming crop is also uncertain due to excessive wetness, disease and limited access to chemicals, with risks potentially compounded by an unusually strong El Niño. Production forecasts for major growers have been lowered, with Ivory Coast’s output expected to fall by about 20% to 1.75 million tonnes and Ghana’s to decline 13% to 650,000 tonnes next season. Elsewhere, farmers in Cameroon are struggling with shortages of chemicals to control pests and diseases, while floods have disrupted cocoa farming in Nigeria.

Mexico Factory Activity Weakens — The S&P Global Mexico Manufacturing PMI fell to 49.8 in August 2026 from 51.3 in the prior month, signaling a renewed deterioration in operating conditions. A reduction in factory output weighed most, marking the steepest contraction in eight months as firms reported subdued market conditions, material shortages and shipping delays linked to the conflict in the Middle East. Demand also weakened, as new order growth slowed from recent peaks, reflecting a fall in new export orders at the quickest pace in 2026 so far. As a response, manufacturers trimmed their purchasing activity, marking the first reduction in three months. Stocks of purchases also fell, while fineshed goods inventories rose slitghly. In turn, cost pressures continued to moderate, as the input cost inflation slipped to a five-month low, although still elevated amid US tariff and Middle East uncertainty. Looking ahead, sentiment turned pessimistic, with firms citing concerns over general market uncertainty.

【道明證券：美財政部加碼長債回購料使10年期期限溢價下降約5個基點】道明證券表示，美國財政部計劃將10年至30年期國債回購規模“至少提高一倍”，如果每次操作的最高回購規模為40億美元，可能令10年期國債期限溢價下降約5個基點。道明證券利率策略師Molly Brooks在一份研究報告中表示：“如果財政部將每次回購操作的最高規模提高至40億美元，每季度可進一步減少180億美元的長端國債供給。我們估計，這將使期限溢價下降約5個基點”。Brooks稱，目前期限溢價已下降約13個基點，“這表明部分市場參與者可能預期回購規模會更大，或者長期國債拍賣規模可能下降”。Brooks表示，縮減長端國債拍賣規模將更符合財政部“定期且可預測”的發債策略，並稱，如果偏離這一可預測模式，反而可能推高期限溢價，並抵消減少長端供給帶來的好處。

Wheat Rises Toward 3-1/2-Year High — Wheat rose to around $7.65 per bushel, close to its highest level since February 2023, as renewed attacks in the Black Sea region heightened concerns over grain supplies. Turkey said it had prepared a plan to facilitate the safe movement of grain through the Black Sea and was in contact with both Russia and Ukraine. However, Moscow rejected a proposed moratorium on attacks in the area, arguing that it would not contribute to a peaceful resolution. Ukrainian officials said Russian strikes overnight damaged port facilities and a border crossing with Romania in the Odesa region, while further attacks were reported near Russia’s Baltic port of Ust-Luga. The renewed hostilities have increased uncertainty around exports from both countries, with previous attacks severely disrupting shipments through Black Sea and Sea of Azov ports. Both countries are major exporters, together accounting for more than a quarter of global wheat shipments.

【美國7月職位空缺小幅增加 反映勞動力需求穩定】美國7月職位空缺小幅增加，裁員人數下降，顯示企業用工需求仍在較低水平上保持穩定。美國勞工統計局週二公佈的資料顯示，7月職位空缺從6月下修後的718萬個升至727萬個。接受調查的經濟學家的預期中值為731萬個。報告顯示，美國勞動力市場仍延續過去幾年較為典型的“低招聘、低裁員”格局。面對地緣政治不確定性和持續通脹，企業對擴大員工規模保持謹慎，但同時也不願大規模裁員。職位空缺增加主要由製造業、州和地方政府（不包括教育領域），以及醫療保健和社會援助行業推動。其中，製造業職位空缺升至2023年12月以來最高水平，而休閒和酒店業職位空缺降至2021年以來最低。與此同時，裁員人數降至今年1月以來最低水平。製造業解僱人數則降至五年多來的最低。衡量員工每月主動離職比例的所謂離職率小幅降至1.9%。報告還顯示，每名失業者大約對應1.1個職位空缺。該比率在2022年高點時曾達到2比1，美聯儲官員經常用這一指標衡量勞動力供需平衡狀況。

【SpaceX重組資料中心領導團隊】近期，SpaceX對旗下資料中心建設團隊進行了高層人事調整，多名負責人被替換，接任者主要來自公司火箭與衛星網際網路業務。知情人士透露，此舉源於田納西州和密西西比州現有資料中心設施在土木工程與執行可靠性方面持續暴露問題。早期建設階段，SpaceX的AI部門（SpaceXAI）為追求速度，部分設施在數月內缺乏備用冷卻和電力系統，增加了宕機風險。人事變動方面，前獵鷹火箭和龍飛船生產副總裁Wesley Salandro、星艦基地（Starbase）發射場產品支援運營總監Logan McConnell已加入AI基礎設施團隊。此外，SpaceX還從Neuralink引入一名工程師協助土木工程，並持續招聘相關崗位。與此同時，資料中心團隊多名核心成員近期離職：負責物理基礎設施的Jake Palmer於7月底離開（其於2025年9月加入），另有Zach Wells、Pablo Mendoza等；此前，負責場地建設的Brent Mayo已跳槽至OpenAI，從特斯拉Dojo超級計算機專案加入的Liz Balke也轉投Anthropic。

Dallas Fed Business Activity Slows — The general business activity index for the Dallas Fed’s service sector fell to 4.2 in August 2026 from 6.6 in the prior month. Despite the modest decline in optimism, the index remained in positive territory, indicating continued improvement in broader business conditions, while uncertainty was broadly unchanged. The revenues index declined to 6.6 from 9.5, while the company outlook index fell sharply to 3.0 from 10.4. Input price pressures intensified, with the index rising to 35.6 from 33.5, while selling-price growth eased to 8.9 from 14.2. Capital spending also weakened to 6.0 from 11.5. Labor-market conditions softened, with the employment index falling to 0.8 from 2.6, although wages and benefits edged higher. Looking ahead, firms remained optimistic, with the future general business activity index rising to 18.6 from 16.8.

【盛秋平會見福特汽車公司總裁兼執行長吉姆·法利一行】據“南昌釋出”，9月1日，江西省委常委、南昌市委書記盛秋平會見了福特汽車公司總裁兼執行長吉姆·法利一行。盛秋平指出，希望福特汽車堅定在昌發展信心，持續深化與江鈴集團合作，不斷健全合作對接機制，進一步創新合作模式、拓展合作領域，助推南昌汽車產業轉型升級。南昌將持續打造近悅遠來的營商環境，強化要素保障、提升服務效能，全力支援福特汽車及廣大合作伙伴在昌發展。吉姆·法利表示，南昌區位優勢明顯、產業基礎紮實、營商環境優越、發展前景廣闊，福特汽車高度重視在昌業務發展，將進一步深化與江鈴集團務實合作，充分發揮各自優勢，把握發展趨勢、共享發展機遇，攜手拓展國際市場，推動江鈴集團發展邁上新臺階，為南昌經濟社會高質量發展注入新的動能。

【瑞銀在瑞士資本新規博弈中暫獲支援】瑞士議員委員會近日投票支援一項折中方案，允許瑞銀（UBS）以發行債券的方式滿足新資本要求的一半，另一半則需透過增發股權來完成。這意味著瑞銀可大幅降低籌資成本，被市場視為階段性勝利。不過，該方案仍需瑞士議會兩院最終表決，尚未塵埃落定。2023年瑞銀緊急收購瑞信後，瑞士政府著手修訂針對系統重要性銀行的資本規則，擬要求瑞銀持有遠高於當前的資本，以防範其美、英大型子公司一旦崩盤拖累整個集團。瑞銀則堅決反對加碼，認為瑞信倒閉源於商業模式失敗和治理薄弱，而非資本不足。瑞銀計劃採用的AT1債券（應急可轉債）本為銀行提供額外損失緩衝，但此類工具爭議不斷——瑞士當局在救助瑞信時直接將170億美元AT1債券減記至零，持有人蒙受鉅額損失，多起訴訟至今未了結。

TSX Falls on Rising Global Yields — The S&P/TSX Composite Index fell more than 0.5% to trade below 36,500 on Tuesday amid rising global bond yields. Renewed hostilities in the Middle East lifted oil prices, prompting markets to reassess expectations for interest rate hikes by central banks. The BoC is expected to leave rates unchanged on Wednesday, while Canada’s 10-year yield reached a near two-week high. Financial stocks traded mostly lower, while higher yields also weighed on gold prices, pressuring miners. Agnico Eagle fell nearly 3%, while Barrick, WPM and Franco-Nevada lost about 2%. Tech stocks extended losses, with Shopify down more than 3.5%. In contrast, energy stocks gained, with Canadian Natural, Suncor and Cenovus adding around 2% each.

Ibovespa Rises on Enegy Gains and Selic Cut Expectations — The Ibovespa rose nearly 1% to trade close to 179,000 on Tuesday, supported by energy shares and renewed expectations of continued Selic easing. Petrobras gained more than 1.5% as renewed hostilities in the Middle East lifted oil prices, while PRIO added over 1%. Higher energy costs and expectations of a Fed hike pushed global bond yields higher, pressuring financials and broader markets. Still, signs of a gradual moderation in economic activity raised expectations for further Selic cuts, supporting the index. Brazil’s GDP grew 0.5% in the second quarter of 2026, but a decline in household spending reflected weakness for consumers. Although the BCB has begun an easing cycle, the Selic rate remains elevated at 14%. Utilities were mostly higher, while retailers gained about 1%.

【伊朗：不允許美國讓船隻從霍爾木茲海峽南線透過的企圖】伊朗議會議長卡利巴夫表示，美國想違反諒解備忘錄，讓船隻從霍爾木茲海峽南線透過，伊朗絕不允許。卡利巴夫稱，（美以伊）衝突前，每天至少有120艘船隻透過霍爾木茲海峽，現在的船隻通航量遠不及戰前，霍爾木茲海峽完全由伊朗軍方控制。美國企圖讓幾艘船隻透過該海峽，但遭到伊朗抵抗。卡利巴夫說，“如果該海峽的控制權掌握在美國手中，他們為何還要不斷攻擊伊朗島嶼？美國人謊稱船只可以通行，但這些船隻卻遭到襲擊。”卡利巴夫強調，伊朗掌控了戰場，並讓敵人意識到他們無法阻止伊朗的導彈。在接下來的階段，伊朗將在質和量上都佔據絕對優勢。 (央視新聞)

【近7.79萬億地方債圖譜：新增專項債加速追趕 再融資債佔比過半】今年以來，積極財政政策靠前發力、精準施策的訊號，在地方政府債券市場上得到了充分印證。截至8月末，全國地方政府債券年內發行總量達到77859.14億元。多位市場分析人士表示，當前供給節奏既體現了財政政策“提質增效”的導向，也折射出“穩增長”與“化風險”雙重目標下的統籌平衡。再融資債券放量緩釋償債壓力，新增專項債後半程加速追趕進度，兩者共同構築了地方財政的良性迴圈。（新華財經）
【美聯邦航空管理局擬限制特朗普佛州住所附近空域飛行】記者獲悉，美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）當天表示，擬在佛羅里達州棕櫚灘特朗普國際機場附近實施特殊飛行規定，理由是出於對特朗普位於海湖莊園住所的安全擔憂。美國聯邦航空管理局擬限制該住所周邊半徑約1.85公里、距地面約610米以內空域的飛行活動。（央視新聞）

US Economic Optimism Recovers Less than Expected — The RealClearMarkets/TIPP Economic Optimism Index rose to 45.6 in Septemer of 2026 from 45.1 in the previous month, missing expectations of 46.2, but still enough to mark the highest level since March. The gain was caried by greater confidence among investors and higher-income households, offsetting a deterioration in sentiment for non-investors and lower-income households. The six-month outlook rose to 41.3 from 39.9, and the personal financial outlook index fell to 52.7 from 53. Meanwhile, the index measuring confidence in economic policy by the federal government rose to 42.9 from 42.3.
【美國財長貝森特淡化霍爾木茲海峽重要性 稱將在兩年內被繞開】美國財政部長斯科特·貝森特週二淡化了霍爾木茲海峽的重要性。他表示，這條在近期衝突中由伊朗控制、對波斯灣能源運輸至關重要的水道，很快將被輸油管道繞開。“將在兩年內被繞開，”貝森特在北卡羅來納州阿什維爾舉行的全球財長會議期間與Larry Kudlow對談時表示。“兩年內，霍爾木茲海峽將像一片毫無價值的水域。”

【伊朗稱外匯儲備充足】伊朗中央銀行行長阿卜杜勒納賽爾·赫馬提9月1日表示，儘管受到美國製裁，伊朗外匯儲備依然充足。伊朗塔斯尼姆通訊社援引赫馬提的表態報道，伊朗央行已準備好向外匯市場注入20億美元，以穩定近期波動。伊朗將讓美國知道，伊朗不僅有外匯，且其儲備充足。赫馬提說，儘管伊朗遭遇困難，但經濟從未崩潰，將來也不會崩潰。（新華社）

【全球債市“壓艙石”鬆動 日本10年期收益率重返3%意味著什麼？】全球債券市場迎來又一個歷史性時刻。9月1日盤中，10年期日債收益率一度升至3%，為1996年10月以來首次突破這一關鍵心理關口。這一變動不僅意味著日本債券市場執行邏輯或迎來根本性轉變，更引發了一場席捲歐美等地的全球債市拋售潮。業內人士表示，這場劇烈拋售恰逢中東局勢再度升級，布倫特原油期貨價格重返每桶91美元上方，通脹擔憂捲土重來。與此同時，美國政府債務突破40萬億美元、日本政府計劃擴大財政支出、科技巨頭為AI基礎設施大規模融資，多重因素疊加，正在深刻重塑全球債券市場的定價邏輯。道富環球投資管理東京高階固定收益策略師提供了一個關鍵洞察，“10年期日債收益率觸及3%無疑是一個里程碑，但我更傾向於將其視為正常化程序，而非危機訊號。市場正在為更高通脹環境、更高中性利率以及日央行進一步加息的預期進行重新定價。”他進一步指出，真正值得關注的不是大規模資金突然迴流，而是日本逐漸“不再成為海外債券的邊際買家”。（新華財經）

US Construction Spending Falls 0.5% in July — Construction spending in the US fell 0.5% month-over-month to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of $2,158 billion in July 2026, following a upwardly revised flat reading in June and missing market expectations of a flat reading. Residential construction spending fell 1.3%, while nonresidential spending edged up 0.1%. Within the nonresidential sector, the largest declines were recorded in conservation and development (-1.4%), manufacturing (-1%) and public safety (-1%). These were partly offset by gains in office construction (2.9%). Meanwhile, both private (-0.5%), dragged by a 3.2% decline in new single family residential construction spending, and public (-0.2%) construction spending fell over the month. In the first seven months of 2026, total construction spending fell 3.5% from the same period a year earlier to $1.245 trillion.

US Manufacturing Activity Revised Higher: S&P Global — The S&P Global US Manufacturing PMI was at 53.9 for a third consecutive month in August of 2026, revised higher from the flash estimate of 53.2, and aligned with the initial market expectations. Both output and new order growth eased in the period. Surveyees noted higher cost levels, with input inflation remaining well above the historical levels due to tariff uncertainties and the war in the Middle East, forcing companies to raise their charges. These developments drove firms to cite muted client appetite, resulting in the slowdown for new business. Still, higher production environments had manufacturers raise their purchasing activity for the eighth month running. Looking ahead, companies remained optimistic about their business, underpinning another period of employment growth.

US Job Quits Fall in July — The number of workers voluntarily leaving their jobs in the United States decreased by 157,000 to 3.06 million in July 2026, from a revised 3.21 million in the prior month. Quits fell primarily in accommodation and food services (-86,000); professional and business services (-77,000) and other services (-49,000). By region, quits declined in the West (-265,000) and the Northeast (-22,000) but increase in the Midwest (+114,000) and the South (+16,000). The quits rate edged down to 1.9% from 2%, remaining near its lowest level since 2020 and signaling continued reluctance among workers to quit.

【機構：拉美智慧手機市場第二季度同比下降12%】根據Omdia的最新分析，拉丁美洲智慧手機市場在2026年第二季度（2Q2026）同比下降12%，至3030萬部。DRAM與NAND成本上漲傳導至零售價格，對入門級裝置的需求衝擊最為沉重。供應商與渠道商在第一季度曾透過前置發貨和庫存緩衝部分緩解了這一影響。這些保護措施在第二季度有所減弱，市場低端面臨的壓力進一步暴露，而中端、高階與旗艦細分市場則仍保持相對韌性。

US Manufacturing Growth Slows in August — The ISM Manufacturing PMI fell to 54.6 in August 2026 from July’s near four-year high of 55.6, below market expectations of 55.2. The reading nevertheless marked the eighth consecutive month of expansion in manufacturing activity, although growth moderated as new orders slowed sharply to 53.7 from 56.7. Production growth was broadly stable at 58.3, compared with 58.5 in July, while employment growth eased to 51.2 from 52.8, pointing to a softer pace of job creation in the sector. Meanwhile, manufacturers continued to highlight rising costs, supply-chain disruptions and heightened uncertainty, with tariffs and the Middle East conflict adding further pressure. The Prices Index remained elevated at 71.1, while the Supplier Deliveries Index rose to 59.3, signaling continued supply-chain delays. The Backlog of Orders Index fell sharply to 51.8, while the Imports Index declined to 52.5, suggesting weaker order pipelines and import activity.

US Job Openings Below Forecasts — Job openings in the US increased by 89,000 to 7.271 million in July 2026 from a downwardly revised 7.182 million in June, below market expectations of 7.30 million. The number of job openings increased in durable goods manufacturing (+76,000), health care and social assistance (+54,000), wholesale trade (+50,000), and construction (+28,000). On the other hand, job openings fell in transportation, warehousing, and utilities (-67,000) and professional and business services (-65,000). Regionally, openings rose in the Midwest (84,000) and the West (135,000), but fell in the Northeast (-28,000), and the South (-102,000). Over the month, hires and total separations both changed little at 5.1 million. Within separations, quits (3.1 million) and layoffs and discharges (1.7 million) were little changed.

【貝森特：霍爾木茲海峽將在兩年內實現“繞道通行” 美國將繼續加碼伊朗制裁】美國財長貝森特在G20會議上的爐邊談話中指出，美國能源領域的“3-3-3”計劃針對的是原油當量，自特朗普上任以來，美國日均石油產量已增加160萬至220萬桶。他說，表示必須降低風險，霍爾木茲海峽將在兩年內實現“繞道通行”，屆時該海峽將變成“毫無價值的水域”，石油將透過陸地管道運輸而非霍爾木茲海峽。談及伊朗問題時，他提到，85%-90%的伊朗工廠具備重建能力，且伊朗可能擁有世界第三大能源資源。另外，美國可能將在本週和下週宣佈銀行制裁，並已獲得歐盟、歐洲央行、英國、阿聯酋和巴林的強力支援，對伊朗零容忍，將在經濟上扼殺其發展；美國還將關注與伊朗有關的航空租賃公司。貝森特稱：“我們知道英屬維爾京群島與伊朗有關的賬戶，從伊朗人民那裡竊取的資金可以歸還給他們，也可以用伊朗資金幫助恐怖主義受害者。”

Canada Manufacturing PMI Holds Expansion — The S&P Global Canada Manufacturing PMI edged lower to 53.0 in August 2026 from 53.5 in July, remaining above the 50.0 no-change threshold for a fifth consecutive month. Production and new orders both increased for the fifth straight month, with output growth accelerating to its fastest pace since April. Employment also rose, with job creation reaching its strongest level since October 2024. Manufacturers increased purchasing activity and marginally raised input inventories, partly reflecting precautionary buying amid concerns over prices and product availability. Input cost inflation remained elevated despite easing, while output price inflation also slowed from July. Meanwhile, business confidence strengthened in August, reaching its highest level since late 2024.

US Stocks Drop Sharply — US stocks fell on Tuesday on growing concerns that tight financial conditions will hamper economic growth. The S&P 500 and the Dow fell up to 0.7%, while the Nasdaq 100 fell nearly 2%. Strikes between the US and Iran in the Persian Gulf prolonged the suspension of energy exports from the region and added to pro-inflationary risks on the global economy, consolidating the likelihood that major central banks are due to restart their hiking cycles this year. On top of that, soaring AI corporate debt issuance added to credit supply and lifted yields further. Tech stocks led the losses on tightened credit conditions, with Marvell, Intel, Oracle, and Tesla dropping around 3%. Meanwhile, Nvidia dropped 2% despite te $35 billion computing deal between Lambda, where the chip giant has a large stake, and Anthropic. Meanwhile, asset managers fell further with Blackstone and KKR dropping 4% each.

Arabica Coffee Futures at Over 2-Month Low — Arabica coffee futures eased toward $3 per pound, reaching their lowest since late June, pressured by expectations of higher output from top producer Brazil. The 2026/27 coffee harvest was 97% complete by August 26, according to Safras & Mercado, with Arabica at 96% and the country on track for a potentially record crop..Rabobank echoed the favorable supply outlook, saying it still expects a “very comfortable” global coffee balance in 2026/27, with a surplus of 8.9 million bags. However, it noted that delays in Brazil and earthquake-related problems in Colombia are keeping stocks tight, with significant replenishment unlikely before November.. Arabica coffee stocks monitored by ICE continued to fall, reaching 223,976 bags by August 31, the lowest level in 27 years. Meanwhile, next year’s harvest remained in focus, with the outlook clouded by erratic weather and the risk of a strong El Niño potentially delaying critical rainfall during the September-October flowering period.

Bank of Israel Cuts Key Rate to 3.25% — The Bank of Israel lowered its policy rate by 25 bps to 3.25% at its September 2026 meeting, missing markets expectations of a hold, delivering a third straight rate cut and bringing the policy rate to its lowest level since 2022. Policymakers noted that inflation has moderated, and the rate under review is below the mid-point of the target range of 1%-3%. Meanwhile, economic activity grew at a rapid pace in the first half of the year, while, excluding production abroad, activity appears more moderate. However, policymakers also noted that uncertainty remained high against the backdrop of geopolitical tensions, although the risk premium remained near similar levels. Labor market conditions remain tight, although with a slightly increase in broad unemployment. Looking ahead, inflation is expected to remain near the mid-point of the target range.

【BARR: Fed should hike decisively if inf fails to cool】Federal Reserve Governor BARR said on Tuesday in Washington the Fed should be prepared to raise rates if inf does not cool. He warned inf has run above target for more than five years, creating a risk of entrenched price pressures. Brazil Manufacturing PMI Weakens — The S&P Global Brazil Manufacturing PMI fell to 46.3 in August 2026 from 47.5 in July, signaling a second consecutive monthly deterioration in sector conditions and the steepest contraction in 40 months. Output declined for the fourth consecutive month and at the fastest pace in more than three years. New business fell for the seventeenth straight month, with the contraction accelerating from July. New export orders declined for the fourth consecutive month and at the fastest pace in more than three-and-a-half years. Weaker demand weighed on staffing and capacity, with employment falling for a second month and at the fastest pace since October 2025. Backlogs also declined further. Inventory and purchasing data pointed to cautious operating conditions, while price pressures eased for a fourth consecutive month. Despite the weak activity data, manufacturers remained optimistic about the year-ahead outlook.

【瑞銀最新研判：A股風險因素邊際改善，市場重回多板塊輪動】“這輪調整更多體現為市場在前期上漲後的風險釋放，而非中期趨勢的根本性逆轉。隨著融資餘額回落，市場去槓桿程序逐步接近尾聲。與此同時，維護資本市場平穩執行的積極因素正加速累積，市場修復基礎持續夯實，這些都有助於下半年‘慢牛’行情的延續。”瑞銀全球研究部亞太區總監連沛堃9月1日在瑞銀證券A股研討會上稱。瑞銀全球金融市場部中國主管房東明也稱，在風險逐步釋放、政策預期改善和盈利趨勢向好的共同作用下，A股市場正在進入修復和重估的新階段。相較上半年A股市場行情高度集中於科技板塊，瑞銀中國股票策略研究主管王宗豪認為，AI相關板塊仍值得持續關注，但下半年投資者也會關注非AI板塊，多板塊輪動機會增多。瑞銀證券中國股票策略分析師孟磊也稱，看好成長風格，但對大盤、小盤的相對風格配置，建議投資者進行更為均衡的配置。（第一財經）

【Dreame Technology halts car mass-production plan; auto unit folded into research institute, MOVA partly retained】On Sept. 1 Dreame Technology said it has abandoned plans for mass production of vehicles and will fold auto-related operations into the company’s industry research institute, shifting the unit to focus on generic technology exploration and tech commercialization. Dreame said it will retain only technical reserves for the car project. MOVA, launched in 2024 as a global high-end AI smart‑life brand covering robot vacuums, floor washers, lawn mowers, personal-care appliances and planned consumer electronics, will not be fully shut. Chile IMACEC Declines More Than Expected — Chile’s IMACEC economic activity index fell 1.5% year-on-year in July 2026 after rising a downwardly revised 2% in June, missing forecasts for a 0.4% increase and marking the sharpest decline since March 2026. Goods production fell 3.2%, driven by a 9.3% decline in mining, particularly copper, due to lower ore grades, maintenance work and adverse weather. Manufacturing output fell 3.1%, also affected by weather, with lower production of fuels and chemical products. Services declined 0.7%, reflecting weaker personal, business, transportation, restaurant and hotel services. Trade activity rose 0.7%, driven by retail sales, partly offset by lower wholesale activity. The non-mining IMACEC fell 0.3%. On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, economic activity decreased 1.7%.

【*ST清越：可能被實施重大違法強制退市】*ST清越公告稱，公司因涉嫌定期報告等財務資料虛假記載被中國證監會立案調查，於2026年9月1日收到《行政處罰事先告知書》，根據告知書認定情況，公司可能觸及科創板上市規則規定的重大違法行為，可能被實施重大違法強制退市，公司股票將繼續被實施退市風險警示及其他風險警示。截至公告披露日，公司尚未收到立案調查事項的正式處罰決定，最終結果以中國證監會出具的正式處罰決定書為準，敬請投資者注意投資風險。

【*ST清越：收到證監會行政處罰事先告知書】*ST清越公告稱，公司收到中國證監會《行政處罰事先告知書》。經查，公司涉嫌欺詐發行、資訊披露違法違規：證券發行檔案編造重大虛假內容，2020年至2022年上半年分別虛增利潤總額337.40萬元、764.53萬元、2358.16萬元，佔各當期利潤總額的5.56%、15.58%、131.74%；2022年度虛增利潤總額4711.56萬元，佔當期披露利潤總額的108.53%，2023年上半年虛增利潤總額4753.60萬元，佔當期披露利潤總額絕對值的145.10%，且未及時披露補繳4441.99萬元出口退稅款事項。證監會擬對公司責令改正、給予警告，並處1.72億元罰款；對高裕弟等4名相關責任人分別處以400萬元至1050萬元不等罰款，並分別採取3至8年證券市場禁入措施。公司可能觸及重大違法強制退市情形，最終處罰結果以證監會正式決定書為準。

【俄方說盧甘斯克地區多輛汽車遭襲致4死3傷】俄羅斯方面任命的盧甘斯克地區領導人帕謝奇尼克9月1日在社交媒體發文說，烏克蘭武裝部隊當天使用無人機襲擊該地區多輛民用汽車，造成4人死亡、3人受傷。帕謝奇尼克表示，所有傷員均已及時獲得醫療救助。帕謝奇尼克還稱，在過去24小時內，烏軍襲擊了該地區9個市鎮的汽車、居民樓、工業區和民用基礎設施。目前，俄聯邦偵察委員會工作人員正在對此次烏軍襲擊造成的後果進行調查。（新華社）

【2026年夏季成為英國有氣象記錄以來最熱夏季】當地時間9月1日，英國氣象局表示，2026年夏季成為英國自1884年有氣象記錄以來最熱夏季。根據英國氣象局對6月至8月的統計資料，平均氣溫超過了2025年創下的紀錄。今年春夏英國持續高溫，出現5次大範圍熱浪，氣溫達到或超過30攝氏度的天數達40天，打破1995年34天的紀錄；達到或超過35攝氏度的天數為10天，是此前紀錄的兩倍。（央視新聞）

【歐洲央行管委雷恩：我們承受不起歐洲出現購買力危機】歐洲央行一位高層政策官員警告，歐洲央行必須為中東地區一場曠日持久的消耗戰做好準備，該局勢或將推高歐元區通脹。此番表態發表於市場預期歐洲央行將於下週加息的背景之下。 雷恩在接受採訪時談及受衝突推升的能源價格，以及霍爾木茲海峽航運通道近乎封鎖的現狀，他表示：“面對這些通脹壓力，我們絕不能自滿。我們承受不起歐洲出現購買力危機。” 雷恩並未公開明確支援9月加息，但他表示，市場對下週會議的定價“可以理解”。對於後續利率決策，他態度更為審慎，指出廣泛存在的地緣政治不確定性，利率政策必須“逐次會議評估”。雷恩警示稱：“我們必須做好衝突長期化的準備。特朗普政府與伊朗革命衛隊雙方訴求完全對立，中東或將陷入一場消耗戰。” 他同時指出，歐元區今年經濟增長展現出“驚人韌性”，面對高能源價格與貿易緊張，經濟體的表現好於市場此前擔憂。

【Foreign investment in UK energy falls to 12-year low】Foreign investment in the UK energy sector fell to a 12-year low, with foreign-backed projects halving to 27 last year, Ernst & Young data showed. Oil and gas projects fell to three from 16 a year earlier. The Labour government has paused new North Sea drilling and retained a windfall tax on oil and gas producers; the sector is braced for Chancellor John Healey’s first budget, where tax rates may rise further, and uncertainty remains over approval of new drilling licences. An Ernst & Young survey of foreign investors cited high UK energy costs as the biggest deterrent, along with concerns about political stability and high labour costs; respondents identified an uncertain economic outlook—covering growth, interest rates and public debt—as the principal risk to UK attractiveness over the next three years.

Mexico Manufacturing Confidence Edges Higher — Mexico’s manufacturing business confidence edged 0.1 point higher to 48.1 in August 2026 from July, remaining below the 50-point threshold for 18 consecutive months. Manufacturers’ assessment of the current time as appropriate for investment rose 1.4 points to 34.4. Their assessment of current business conditions was unchanged at 50.4 points. Firms’ assessment of the country’s current economic situation edged 0.3 point lower to 47.8, while expectations for the country’s future economic situation fell 0.1 point to 51.9. Expectations for the future economic situation of their companies edged 0.3 point lower to 55.9.

【美軍或為防伊朗轉移黑鷹】近日有媒體報道稱，在約旦某處美軍基地附近拍到美軍用拖車裝載兩架“黑鷹”直升機駛離的畫面。有分析指出，這有可能是美軍為預防伊朗反擊而做出的舉動。還有分析稱，由於在約旦的美軍基地此前就曾遭伊朗打擊，此次用拖車裝載的“黑鷹”可能本身就已無法飛行。 當地時間8月30日晚，美軍襲擊伊朗南部拉臘克島。伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊隨即對位於約旦的美軍基地發動打擊。美國總統特朗普8月31日對美國媒體稱，防空系統攔截了伊朗向約旦美軍目標發射的導彈，“僅有一枚未被攔截”。（CCTV國際時訊）

【歐元區國債收益率創多年來新高】受全球債券市場拋售影響，歐元區國債收益率當地時間9月1日繼續走高。德國10年期國債收益率升至3.36%，創15年來新高；30年期收益率升至3.845%，為2011年以來最高；法國10年期國債收益率升至4.21%，創2008年以來最高；義大利10年期國債收益率也觸及4.22%，為2023年以來最高。分析認為，中東衝突推高全球能源成本，加劇通脹壓力，同時科技巨頭大量發債以及市場對部分國家財政狀況的擔憂，也進一步推高國債收益率。（央視新聞）

India’s Current Account Deficit Widens on Higher Trade Gap — India’s current account deficit widened to $4.2 billion, or 0.5% of GDP, in Q1 of fiscal 2026-27, from $3.4 billion, or 0.4% of GDP, a year earlier. The increase was driven by a wider goods trade deficit, which rose to $86.1 billion from $68.9 billion as imports jumped 20% to $218.0 billion amid higher energy prices, while exports grew 17.1% to $132.0 billion. The impact was partly offset by an improvement in the primary income balance, with the deficit narrowing to $10.5 billion from $13.3 billion. Meanwhile, the services surplus rose to $51.6 billion from $47.9 billion, while the secondary income surplus increased to $40.8 billion from $30.9 billion.

【美眾議院尋求對消費者金融保護局進行重大改革】美國眾議院金融服務委員會主席、阿肯色州共和黨眾議員弗倫奇·希爾（French Hill），以及領導該委員會金融機構小組委員會的肯塔基州共和黨眾議員安迪·巴爾（Andy Barr），週二提出了一項法案，尋求對消費者金融保護局（CFPB）進行重大改革。CFPB長期以來一直是共和黨的主要改革目標。該法案將透過國會為CFPB提供資金，使這一機構更加直接地受國會議員控制。目前，消費者金融保護局的資金來自美聯儲轉撥，而這種資金安排一直存在爭議。該法案還將針對CFPB的規則制定程式建立新的監管護欄。其中包括允許白宮管理和預算辦公室（OMB）主任羅素·沃特（Russ Vought）在重大規則正式生效後的最長八年內，對這些規則進行追溯性審查。

【“貨幣貶值交易”再度升溫 金礦股創數十年來最佳8月表現】過去一個月，金礦股近乎垂直上漲，吸引了此前因華盛頓政策制定者釋放不同訊號而頻繁遭遇市場波動的投資者重新入場。地緣政治動盪和財政不確定性推動金礦股在八月創下至少自1994年以來的最佳表現，漲幅超過現貨黃金的三倍多。儘管美聯儲主席沃什承諾抑制通脹後，市場在8月底經歷劇烈波動，但紐約證交所Arca金礦股指數仍上漲33%，從3月創下的歷史高點回落39%後強勁反彈。VanEck黃金礦業ETF(GDX)錄得2月以來最高的月度資金流入。而金價本身在8月份僅上漲了10%。美國財政部試圖壓低長期借貸成本，促使投資者重新湧向黃金及相關資產。由於成本相對固定，礦業公司能夠放大金價上漲帶來的收益，因此被視為押注貴金屬進一步上漲的槓桿工具。

【From partners to courtroom: Apple-OpenAI clash underscores intensifying AI competition】Apple sued OpenAI in federal court in July 2026, accusing the company of stealing trade secrets and using Apple intellectual property to build its own consumer hardware. Apple alleges OpenAI executives and former Apple employees orchestrated a large-scale effort to obtain confidential information about unreleased Apple products and that OpenAI disclosed Apple secrets when engaging Apple partners. On Aug. 3 Apple sought a preliminary injunction to bar OpenAI from using the disputed information during litigation; OpenAI responded the same week with a blog post saying Apple is wrong and on Aug. 5 asked a federal judge to dismiss the case as meritless. In filings on Aug. 19 Apple pushed the case into discovery; on Aug. 31 OpenAI countered in court papers, saying Apple failed to safeguard its own information and is likely to lose. A hearing on the matter is scheduled for Oct. 1, 2026. Context: Apple and OpenAI began partnering in June 2024 when Apple integrated ChatGPT into iPhone, iPad and Mac, with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman attending Apple’s event. Signs of strain emerged in May 2025 after OpenAI acquired Jony Ive’s startup io for $6.4 billion and signaled an AI hardware push. In Jan. 2026 Apple shifted strategy toward software-led AI integration, partnering with Google to run Apple Intelligence features on Google’s Gemini model and cloud infrastructure.

【"Currency-debasement trade" revives; gold miners post best August in decades】Gold miners surged over the past month, drawing back investors hit by earlier policy-driven volatility. Geopolitical tensions and fiscal uncertainty helped the sector record its strongest August since at least 1994: the NYSE Arca Gold Miners Index rose 33% in August, more than three times the roughly 10% gain in spot gold, rebounding after a 39% drop from March highs. Markets swung late August after Fed chair KEVIN WARSH pledged to curb inf, but VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) posted its largest monthly inflows since February. U.S. Treasury moves to lower long-term borrowing costs pushed flows into gold and related assets; with largely fixed operating costs, miners provide leveraged exposure to higher gold prices.

Brazil GDP Grows More than Expected — The Brazilian GDP expanded by 0.5% in the second quarter of 2026, extending the 1.1% expansion from the first quarter and ahead of market expectations of a 0.4% growth rate. Output remained supported by the elevated level of government spending that has boosted household consumption in recent quarters, in addition to measures to ease access to bank loans. Hence, government expenditure expanded by 0.4% and gross fixed capital formation surged 1.2%. Still, high inflation and borrowing costs due to the widening public deficits reflected some deterioration in household consumption, which contracted by 0.4%. Net foreign demand dented the GDP sharply, with exports falling 0.8% while imports surged 1.8%. From the previous year, the Brazilian GDP expanded by 2%, inching up from the 1.8% in the first quarter.

【月租10萬美元並非稀罕事 紐約富豪大量湧入使曼哈頓住宅租金創新高】紐約曼哈頓租賃市場持續升溫，一批有能力購置數千萬美元豪宅的富裕人群正開始轉向租房，進一步推高當地住宅租金。據報道，今年7月曼哈頓租金中位數升至每月5000美元，創下歷史新高；平均租金同比上漲15%，達6306美元。與此同時，曼哈頓租賃市場整體供應依然偏緊。相關市場資料顯示，當月曼哈頓可出租住宅庫存同比下降39.3%。

【以色列防長稱抓捕一哈馬斯高階成員】以色列國防部長卡茨9月1日稱，不久前，一名巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭抵抗運動（哈馬斯）高階成員被捕。但卡茨沒有說明該人員具體身份，也沒有透露由誰實施的抓捕。卡茨說，以軍在加沙城的行動一直在繼續，以方的政策是“不等待威脅出現”，主動追擊哈馬斯成員、挫敗其行動並摧毀其相關基礎設施。據《耶路撒冷郵報》援引一名以色列官員的話報道，被捕的這名武裝人員是哈馬斯安全機構負責人。據以色列公共廣播公司報道，一支與以軍協同作戰的民兵組織成員9月1日進入加沙城，試圖綁架一名哈馬斯高階指揮官，隨後遭到猛烈攻擊。報道稱，以色列空軍隨後對該地區的目標進行了空襲，以便民兵組織成員撤離。（新華社）

【偉隆股份：實控人範慶偉減持計劃實施完畢】偉隆股份公告稱，公司控股股東、實際控制人範慶偉減持計劃已實施完畢。範慶偉原計劃2026年8月1日至10月29日透過大宗交易減持不超376.32萬股，佔公司總股本的1.49421%。截至公告披露日，範慶偉累計減持376.32萬股，佔公司總股本的1.49421%，其中2026年8月11日、8月31日合計減持278.72萬股，佔公司總股本的1.1067%，本次權益變動觸及1%整數倍。變動後，範慶偉及其一致行動人合計持股1.36億股，佔公司總股本的53.89%。本次權益變動不觸及要約收購，不會導致公司控股股東、實控人發生變化。

【Uber營運長：15年後沒人再買私家車，甚至不再需要駕照】對幾代美國青少年來說，16 歲拿到駕照一直是成長過程中的重要儀式，也意味著第一次真正擁有獨立出行的自由。然而據報道，Uber（優步）總裁兼營運長安德魯 · 麥克唐納認為，這種傳統未來可能不復存在。麥克唐納在做客企業家哈里 · 斯特賓斯主持的 20VC 播客時表示：“未來某一天，也許不是 5 年後，而是 15 年或 20 年後，沒有人再自己買車。到時候大家甚至不需要駕照，因為有其他方式可以解決出行問題。腳踏車和電動滑板車會承擔一部分需求，自動駕駛汽車會承擔一部分，公共交通也會發揮很大作用，但我不認為人們還有必要自己擁有汽車。”

【綠通科技：第三期回購股份累計耗資約3000萬元】綠通科技公告稱，截至2026年8月31日，公司透過集中競價交易方式累計回購股份85.72萬股，佔公司當前總股本的0.60%，最高成交價為40.53元/股，最低成交價為28.76元/股，成交總金額為2999.55萬元（不含交易費用）。本次回購符合公司回購股份方案及相關法律法規要求，公司後續將在回購期限內繼續實施本次回購計劃。

【芯原股份：國家積體電路基金減持0.0941%股份】芯原股份公告稱，持股5%以上股東國家積體電路產業投資基金股份有限公司於2026年8月31日透過集中競價方式減持公司股份49.47萬股，佔公司總股本的0.0941%。本次權益變動前，國家積體電路基金持股比例為5.0941%；變動後持股比例為5.0000%。本次權益變動不會導致公司控制權發生變化。國家積體電路基金此前披露的減持計劃尚未實施完畢，除已披露計劃外，暫無未來12個月內增減持股的明確安排。

US Futures Pull Back Sharply — Futures tracking US equity indices were firmly lower on Tuesday on growing concerns that tight financial conditions will hamper economic growth. Contracts for the S&P 500 and the Dow were 0.5% lower, while those for the Nasdaq 100 fell more than 1%. Strikes between the US and Iran in the Persian Gulf prolonged the suspension of energy exports from the region and added to pro-inflationary risks on the global economy, consolidating the likelihood that major central banks are due to restart their hiking cycles this year. On top of that, soaring AI corporate debt issuance added to credit supply and lifted yields further. Tech stocks led the losses on tightened credit conditions, with Marvell, Intel, and Sandisk dropping more than 2.5%. Also, Amazon, Tesla, and Nvidia fell over 1%.
【四輪提漲來襲，唐山市場主流鋼廠計劃上調焦炭價格】唐山市場主流鋼廠計劃對溼熄焦炭上調100元/噸、幹熄焦炭上調110元/噸，邢臺地區部分鋼廠對溼熄焦炭上調100元/噸、幹熄焦炭上調110元/噸，均自2026年9月3日零點執行。
【樂心醫療：電子血壓計CE符合性證書完成延續註冊】樂心醫療公告稱，公司電子血壓計醫療器械CE符合性證書延續註冊申請已透過審批，證書編號為G15 082800 0052 Rev.00，註冊分類為IIa類，延續後生效日期為2026年9月3日，到期日為2031年9月2日。本次延續註冊為公司全球業務拓展夯實基礎，有利於拓寬海外市場，增強產品綜合競爭力及市場拓展能力，目前尚無法預測其對公司未來業績的影響。

【追覓ECHO系列家庭服務機器人將亮相IFA 2026】9月4日至8日在德國柏林舉行的IFA 2026期間，追覓將以“EMPOWER YOUR DREAM LIFE”為主題參展，集中展示覆蓋超過16個品類的百餘款產品及多項首創技術，涵蓋智慧清潔、生活環境電器、個人護理、擦窗和小廚電等多個家庭場景。據悉，除前述多個品類外，追覓還將首次集中呈現由全域感知系統、家庭通用模型和智慧控制系統構成的三大物理AI技術底座，並展示處於研發階段的ECHO系列家庭服務機器人。

【先導智慧：9月1日回購6.57萬股H股股份】先導智慧公告稱，2026年9月1日公司透過香港聯交所回購65700股H股股份，每股回購價區間為30.18港元-30.98港元，付出總金額為199.66萬港元，所購股份擬持作庫存股份。截至2026年9月1日，公司已發行股份（不含庫存股）為10791.87萬股，庫存股份為13.97萬股，已發行股份總數為10805.84萬股。本次回購屬2026年5月21日透過的回購授權項下操作，該授權可回購股份總數為1080.58萬股，截至目前累計已回購13.97萬股，佔授權透過日已發行股份（不含庫存股）的0.13%，回購後新股發行及庫存股處置暫止期至2026年10月1日。

【聯合動力：2026年上半年淨利潤同比減少且為虧損】聯合動力公告稱，國泰海通證券出具2026年半年度持續督導跟蹤報告，2026年1-6月公司淨利潤同比減少且為虧損，保薦人已提示公司做好相關資訊披露工作。報告期內，保薦機構每月查詢公司募集資金專戶，共發表獨立意見8次，未列席公司股東會、董事會，未開展現場檢查及培訓；公司資訊披露、內部制度執行、三會運作、募集資金使用等方面均無問題，各項承諾均正常履行，無其他重大事項。

【人民銀行上海總部：用好創業擔保貸款等相關政策，更好支援婦女創業企業發展】9月1日，據人民銀行上海總部官微訊息，近日，人民銀行上海總部、上海金融監管局、市婦聯聯合召開金融活水賦能“她發展”——落實金融支援婦女就業發展政策專題座談會。會議介紹了《中國人民銀行  金融監管總局  全國婦聯關於進一步加強金融支援婦女就業發展的實施意見》（以下簡稱《意見》）的出臺背景，並就重點內容進行深入解讀。《意見》是國內金融領域面向女性群體的專項扶持政策，從加大金融資源投入、最佳化教育培訓金融服務、健全保險保障機制、強化服務能力建設、加強政策和組織保障五大維度推出16條舉措。《意見》鼓勵金融機構圍繞“巾幗電商”、手工製作、家政服務等居家靈活就業新模式制定個性化金融服務方案；針對婦女就業創業特點，創新專屬信貸產品和服務模式，提高信貸供給適配性；充分運用金融科技手段，提高獲客能力、風險評估能力和貸款審批效率。
